name: REDATAM
description: REDATAM is statistical software from CELADE/ECLAC for processing, analyzing, and disseminating census, survey, and vital-statistics microdata. National statistics offices publish online catalogs through Redatam Webserver and a REST API for SPC processing jobs.

Nesstar is a legacy microdata and metadata management suite for publishing, browsing, analyzing, and downloading survey and statistical data through Nesstar Repository and WebView, with support for DDI-based metadata workflows.
name: Nesstar

description: NADA (National Data Archive) is an open-source microdata catalog and documentation platform for publishing survey and census metadata with searchable documentation, APIs, and standards-based dissemination workflows.
name: NADA

description: Colectica is a metadata and data documentation platform for statistical, survey, and microdata workflows, supporting standards-based curation, publication, and dissemination through web interfaces and APIs.
name: Colectica

description: Mica is an open-source web platform for discovering, cataloging, and harmonizing epidemiological and population health microdata, providing study metadata management and API-based access for data discovery workflows.
name: Obiba Mica
IPUMS
description: IPUMS is the Integrated Public Use Microdata Series extract and dissemination platform from the University of Minnesota. Harmonized census, survey, and geographic collections (USA, International, CPS, DHS, NHIS, and others) share one extract engine and a REST API for metadata and custom extracts.

Survey Solutions is a World Bank suite for survey data collection and management; the Data Browser provides web access to exported survey microdata and related documentation for authorized dissemination workflows.
name: Survey Solutions
Health Data Center
description: Health Data Center (HDC) is Thailand’s Ministry of Public Health medical and health data warehouse (ระบบคลังข้อมูลด้านการแพทย์และสุขภาพ). Public catalogs sit on hdc.moph.go.th/{tenant}/public/ (national hub /center/public/, provincial สสจ. slugs). Distinct from Health KPI (healthkpi.moph.go.th) and from DDC disease-surveillance apps.

Istat Data Browser (ISTAT StatKit) is an open-source SDMX dissemination portal for browsing, visualizing, and downloading aggregate statistics. Installations expose a SPA under /databrowser/ and a hub JSON API (databrowserhub/api/core or databrowser/api/core), often paired with an SDMX-RI web service.
name: Istat Data Browser
TabNet
description: TabNet is a CGI tabulation application from DATASUS (Brazilian Ministry of Health) used to publish cross-tabulations of SUS health databases (SIM, SINASC, SIH, SIA, CNES, SINAN, and related .DBF files). Windows builds use deftohtm.exe and tabcgi.exe; Linux builds use dh and tabnet. Installations are the national DATASUS site plus state and municipal health secretariats and agencies such as ANS.

name: Cancer-Rates.info
description: Cancer-Rates.info is a multi-tenant cancer incidence and mortality query system hosted by the Kentucky Cancer Registry. Central cancer registries publish county maps, tables, and exports at a unique path on cancer-rates.info / cancer-rates.com. Register only public guest UIs, not login-walled tenant paths.

owner.name: Kentucky Cancer Registry, University of Kentucky

name: Data Insight
description: Enterprise data intelligence platform for discovering, classifying, and governing unstructured data at scale.

name: ActivityInfo
description: ActivityInfo is a hosted information management platform from BeDataDriven for monitoring and evaluation, humanitarian coordination, and multi-partner reporting. UN agencies (OCHA, UNHCR, UNICEF, WHO) and NGOs use it for 4W/5W response monitoring; owners can publish live dashboards and reports as standalone no-login pages or feed public Power BI / Shiny portals through the REST API.

name: BRS Electronic Reporting System Dashboards
description: Shared reporting dashboards of the Secretariat of the Basel, Rotterdam and Stockholm Conventions, built on the BRS Electronic Reporting System (eRS). Each convention runs the same eRSodataReports dashboard application (/eRSodataReports2/...DashBoard.html) over its national-report submissions, with filters by year, region, and country and Excel downloads. Live instances cover the Basel Convention (ers.basel.int) and the Stockholm Convention (ers.pops.int).

owner.name: Secretariat of the Basel, Rotterdam and Stockholm Conventions

capabilities: Filter by year, region, and country

name: Pishu Database
description: 皮书数据库 is the Social Sciences Academic Press platform publishing 'blue book' statistical yearbooks and research report data.

name: Oracle APEX
description: Oracle APEX is a low-code platform for building data-driven web applications, dashboards, and reporting portals on Oracle Database.
capabilities: REST API - Interactive dashboards - SQL-driven reporting - Low-code app builder

name: LiveShop
description: LiveShop is an ASP.NET statistics database platform used by central banks and regional monetary bodies to publish macroeconomic time series. Tenants run on their own domains with a /shop landing page (site title "Home Page - LiveShop"), /shop/meta-data and /shop/data-calendar pages, and a /data-browser chart and table view. Known tenants include the Central Bank of Nigeria (statistics.cbn.gov.ng) and the West African Monetary Institute (wami-data.org). Distinct from DataWarehousePro (datawarehousepro), whose tenants live on the vendor's app.datawarehousepro.com host with /go/{tenant} paths.

name: Idescat
description: Idescat is the statistical dissemination platform of the Statistical Institute of Catalonia (Institut d'Estadistica de Catalunya). It publishes themed indicator tables, municipal profiles (Emex) and SDG indicators, with open REST APIs on api.idescat.cat returning JSON and JSON-stat.

name: CEInet Statistical Database
description: 中经网统计数据库 / 中经数据 is the statistical database service of the China Economic Information Network under the State Information Center, covering macro, regional and industry statistics.

owner.name: China Economic Information Network (State Information Center)

name: Soshoo
description: 搜数网 is China InfoBank's commercial statistical database, one of the oldest Chinese platforms aggregating official statistics into searchable indicator tables.

name: Conduent Healthy Communities Institute
description: Conduent Healthy Communities Institute (HCI) is a multi-tenant community health indicator platform used by US counties, hospital systems, and collaboratives for CHNA dashboards. Public standalone sites reuse HCI chrome (Conduent / Healthy Communities Institute in HTML) with local branding such as Health Matters.

PxStat is an open-source statistical dissemination system from Ireland's Central Statistics Office. It publishes multidimensional tables through a web UI and JSON-RPC/REST APIs (JSON-stat, PX, CSV, XLSX). Distinct from Statistics Sweden's PxWeb.
name: PxStat
Mysteel
description: 我的钢铁网 Mysteel publishes Chinese steel and bulk-commodity price indicators; a benchmark for China steel markets.

name: DataWarehousePro
description: DataWarehousePro is a Wellington-hosted macroeconomic data warehouse used by central banks. Public tenants live at app.datawarehousepro.com/go/{tenant} with guest APIs /guest/getDatabanksWithMnemonics/{tenant} and /guest/export/{tenant}.

name: SDMX-RI
description: SDMX-RI (SDMX Reference Infrastructure) is the SDMX standards-based reference software stack used by statistical organizations to publish and exchange official statistics through interoperable SDMX REST and SOAP interfaces.

name: East Money Data Center
description: 东方财富数据中心 is East Money's free web data portal publishing Chinese macro, market and company indicator tables.

name: Data VAVT
description: Data VAVT is an indicators platform for macro- and microeconomic analysis based on statistics from verified domestic and international sources.

name: Diandian
description: 点点数据 Diandian publishes app store metrics and mobile market indicators.

name: QuestMobile
description: QuestMobile TRUTH is a mobile internet metrics platform publishing Chinese app MAU/DAU indicator panels.

SuperSTAR is a confidential statistical dissemination suite from WingArc Australia (formerly Space-Time Research). SuperWEB2 is the browser table-builder client used by statistical agencies to publish census, survey, and administrative cubes with on-the-fly confidentiality.
name: SuperSTAR
CSMAR
description: 国泰安 CSMAR is an academic research database platform for Chinese financial and economic data, widely used in universities.

name: Qlik Sense
description: Qlik Sense is an enterprise analytics and business-intelligence platform. Public statistical portals (customs, tourism, health) build their indicator dashboards on Qlik Sense hubs and mashups.

name: KS Open Budget
description: KS Open Budget («КС Открытый бюджет. Бюджет для граждан») is Keysystems’ public-finance portal. Regional skins share /Scripts/Site.js (namespaces EB and GZW), /Menu/Page/, /Show/Category/, /Content/Skin*/, /Content/BudgetCalculator/, and jquery.ks.multichoicer.js. The same installation can publish an open-data register. Distinct from NPO Krista iMonitoring (ifinmon.ru) and from other open-budget sites such as budget.lenobl.ru and budget.mos.ru.
capabilities: Regional and municipal budget indicator pages
Open-data register on the same portal

name: CityViz
description: CityViz is a Canadian community economic-development data platform (CityViz Data Solutions, Calgary/Kelowna). Municipalities and regional economic development organizations publish economic indicators, community profiles, business counts, location analytics, and Report Studio exports. Tenants are hosted on vendor subdomains like laclabichecounty.cityviz.ca or on custom domains (for example data.choosecranbrook.ca, insights.medicinehat.ca, data.langleycity.ca). Pages are R Shiny apps titled "Economic Development Data Platform" with "powered by Cityviz" chrome. Do not label the vendor marketing site cityviz.ca itself or the fictional Bellaville showcase as catalogs.
capabilities: Location analytics and site selection maps

description: Legacy OECD.Stat / I.Stat dissemination stack (“Powered by .Stat technology”), predecessor to .Stat Suite Data Explorer. Public UIs are the classic OECD.Stat table browser (OECD.Stat, I.Stat, UNESCO UIS, and similar NSO sites), not Data Explorer. Keep this ID separate from `statsuite` and from Istat Data Browser (`istatdatabrowser`).
name: .Stat Technology
Data.UNICEF.org
description: Data.UNICEF.org is UNICEF's global data and analytics platform that provides indicators, datasets, visualizations, and country profiles focused on child rights and well-being.

name: JAXI
description: JAXI is the Instituto Nacional de Estadística PC-Axis table browser ceded to Spanish regional statistical offices. Public catalogs share /jaxi/Tabla.htm, /jaxiT3/Tabla.htm, or Struts menu.do / tabla.do UIs (IAEAxi, IBESTAT-JAXI) with PC-Axis, spreadsheet, CSV, and sometimes JSON-stat export. Distinct from PxWeb (/api/v1/), PxStat, eDatos, and the INEbase operations CMS.

name: KOSIS
description: KOSIS (KOrean Statistical Information Service) is Statistics Korea’s statistical table platform. Public catalogs are the table tree on kosis.kr (including /bukhan/), agency and local portals that expose /statHtml/statHtml.do (ITSTAT, KISDI media statistics, MediaStat broadcasting statistics, Gyeonggi, Jeonbuk, Jeju, GSIS, KESIS, MOF, MOEL), and ODA clones such as MMSIS, LAOSIS, and ASIS. OpenAPI is documented at /openapi/ and requires a service key. Distinct from local-government /stat/index.do CMS skins that only link out to KOSIS, from 지표누리 (index.go.kr) and SGIS, and from SOPORTAL (indexPage.do with /soportal/ stylesheets).

name: UNdata
description: UNdata is the United Nations Statistics Division’s portal for official demographic, social, and economic statistics compiled from UN system sources. The public catalog is data.un.org. OpenSearch is at /OpenSearch.xml. Do not re-add the hub. Distinct from UN Comtrade Plus, the SDG Global Database, and national NSO table builders.

name: ILOSTAT
description: ILOSTAT is the International Labour Organization's statistics platform providing global labor market indicators, time series data, and analytical tools for employment, wages, productivity, and related socioeconomic topics.

name: Tableau
description: Tableau is a business-intelligence and visualization platform (Salesforce). Public-sector indicator portals commonly embed Tableau Public vizzes or self-hosted Tableau Server views as their interactive statistics layer.

name: WebMain
description: WebMain is Taiwan’s DGBAS-family statistical dynamic-query UI (統計資料動態查詢 / 共通性查詢). Public catalogs share webMain.aspx with sys= and funid= parameters, often under /dgbasall/, /micst/, /statiscla/, /njswww/, /exam/, /statis/, or /edust/. Distinct from local-government DGBAS Web (/DgbasWeb/), from PxWeb on statdb.dgbas.gov.tw, and from ministry portals that only link to a WebMain tree (MOTC Portal, MOENV epanet).

owner.name: Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics

name: Ocean Engine TrendInsight
description: 巨量算数 Ocean Engine TrendInsight publishes Douyin/Toutiao content and consumption trend indicators.

name: Baidu Index
description: 百度指数 Baidu Index publishes search-volume indicators by keyword, region and demographic for the Chinese web.

name: Analysys
description: 易观分析 Analysys is a digital-economy analytics platform publishing Chinese internet industry indicator series.

name: TYPO3
description: TYPO3 is an open-source enterprise content management system. Several statistical offices and monitoring portals, including Statistik Austria, ISTAT, and German regional indicator portals, publish their statistics and indicator pages on TYPO3 rather than dedicated data platforms. French communes also use it for open-data HTML pages.

name: SIDRA
description: SIDRA (Sistema IBGE de Recuperação Automática) is IBGE’s automatic table-retrieval system for Brazilian official statistics. Public catalogs expose the table builder on sidra.ibge.gov.br. The aggregates list API is servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados. Distinct from IBGE Cidades@, Ipeadata, Comex Stat, BCB SGS, and DATASUS TabNet.

owner.name: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística

description: Knoema is a commercial data discovery and dissemination platform for statistical indicators and time series. It is used to host public and institutional data portals with dataset catalogs, visualizations, downloads, and a REST API.
name: Knoema
IDDS
description: IDDS (Interactive Data Dissemination Service) is the Hong Kong Census and Statistics Department custom statistical table platform. Each installation is a themed tenant on its own host — Common-IDDS (idds.censtatd.gov.hk) for social and economic statistics, Trade IDDS (tradeidds.censtatd.gov.hk) for merchandise trade with a documented JSON GET API, and census-round tenants such as the 2021 Population Census IDDS (idds.census2021.gov.hk). Users build custom tables and charts and download the outputs.

name: Goal Tracker
description: Goal Tracker is Data Act Lab's country SDG visualization platform, developed with the Dag Hammarskjöld Foundation. Country tenants use *.goaltracker.org hosts. Distinct from Open SDG (opensdg) static reporting sites.

name: Klimadashboard Münster
description: Klimadashboard Münster is the open-source municipal indicator dashboard published by the City of Münster for climate, energy, and related local metrics. Other cities adapt the same AGPL application. It is distinct from Klimadashboard Deutschland at klimadashboard.de.

name: AskCI
description: 中商情报网 AskCI is an industry research portal publishing per-sector Chinese statistical indicators and market data.

name: GENESIS-Online
description: GENESIS-Online is the statistical database software used by the German Federal Statistical Office (Destatis) and the statistical offices of the Länder. It disseminates official tables and time series through a shared web catalog, downloads, and web-service interfaces.

name: Fingertips
description: Fingertips is the Office for Health Improvement and Disparities (OHID) public health profiles platform for England. The catalog UI and REST API live on fingertips.phe.org.uk (profile collections, indicator metadata, and area values). One national hub — do not add a catalog per local authority or per profile. Distinct from IBIS-PH, Power BI embeds, and InstantAtlas reports.

owner.name: Office for Health Improvement and Disparities

name: Oilchem
description: 隆众资讯 Oilchem publishes Chinese energy and chemical market price indicators.

name: Qimai
description: 七麦数据 Qimai publishes App Store rankings, downloads and ASO indicators for Chinese and global apps.

.Stat Suite is the SIS-CC open-source SDMX platform (Data Explorer UI plus SDMX APIs) for managing the official statistics data lifecycle. Public sites use Data Explorer chrome and `/api/search`. Distinct from the older OECD.Stat / I.Stat “.Stat Technology” stack (`stattech`) and from Istat Data Browser (`istatdatabrowser`).
name: .Stat Suite

description: Grafana is an open-source analytics and interactive visualization platform used to build dashboards over connected data sources. Public instances with anonymous access serve as indicator catalogs of statistical, environmental, or infrastructure dashboards; most deployments are private operations monitors and are out of scope.
name: Grafana
Tonghuashun iFinD
description: 同花顺 iFinD is Tonghuashun's institutional financial data terminal with macro and industry indicator databases.

name: Microsoft Power BI
description: Microsoft Power BI is a business-intelligence platform for interactive dashboards and reports. Statistical agencies and international organizations publish indicator dashboards as public web embeds (app.powerbi.com/view) or on-premises Power BI Report Server portals.

name: Chanmama
description: 蝉妈妈 Chanmama publishes Douyin e-commerce and livestream sales indicators.

name: Contao
description: Contao is an open-source content management system. Several statistical offices and data portals in Germany and Switzerland publish indicator pages on Contao rather than dedicated data platforms.

name: Sxcoal
description: 中国煤炭资源网 Sxcoal publishes Chinese coal market prices, output and inventory indicators.

name: SPIP
description: SPIP is a French open-source content management system. Several French regional observatories and data portals publish indicator pages and statistical dashboards on SPIP rather than dedicated data platforms.

name: East Money Choice
description: 东方财富 Choice is East Money's subscription financial data terminal with macro and industry indicator databases.

name: ChinaBgao
description: 中国报告大厅 ChinaBgao is a report-and-indicator portal covering thousands of Chinese industries.

name: GINES
description: GINES (Georeferenzierte Informations- und Entscheidungssysteme) is a hosted Swiss platform for spatial monitoring of statistical indicators. Cantonal planning and statistics offices use it for maps, time series, and territorial comparisons. The public Bern statistical atlas embeds bern.gines.ch. Other cantonal tenants are often login-only.

name: Tonghuashun Data Center
description: 同花顺数据中心 is Tonghuashun's free web data portal publishing Chinese market, macro and industry indicator tables.

name: DHIS2
description: DHIS2 (District Health Information Software 2) is an open-source health management information system from the HISP Centre at the University of Oslo. National ministries and programmes use it to collect, analyse, and publish routine health indicators, with a REST Web API, analytics endpoints, and optional public portals.

name: IBM Cognos Analytics
description: IBM Cognos Analytics is a business intelligence and analytics platform for creating dashboards, reports, and interactive data visualizations for organizational decision-making.

Beyond 20/20 Web Data Server (WDS) is a proprietary ASP.NET cube browser that publishes multidimensional IVT tables as a public report-folder tree, with interactive table, chart, and map views and per-table downloads (IVT, Excel, CSV).
name: Beyond 20/20 Web Data Server
iMonitoring
description: iMonitoring is NPO Krista’s public-finance and socio-economic indicator platform (KristaBI underneath). Regional Open Budget portals share ifinmon.ru tenants or branded hosts with a data constructor (/servisy/konstruktor-dannyx/ or /konstruktor-dannykh), open-data registers, and fm@krista.ru / fmsupport@krista.ru support. The comparative hub is iminfin.ru. Distinct from Keysystems Open Budget (EB/GZW portals such as budgetzab.75.ru) and from other open-budget sites (Leningrad Oblast, Moscow city).

name: DRCNet Statistical Database
description: 国研网统计数据库 is the statistical database of DRCNet, the information platform affiliated with the Development Research Center of the State Council.

owner.name: DRCNet (Development Research Center of the State Council)

name: NewRank
description: 新榜 NewRank publishes content-platform account metrics across WeChat, Douyin and other Chinese platforms.

name: World Bank Data Platform
description: The World Bank Data platform provides global development indicators, country and regional statistics, and time-series datasets with downloadable files and API access.

name: Chyxx
description: 智研咨询 Chyxx is an industry consulting portal publishing Chinese industry statistics and market indicators.

name: INEbase
description: INEbase is the statistical dissemination platform of Spain's National Statistics Institute (INE). It lists statistical operations and serves indicator tables through the jaxiT3 table browser and the Tempus3 JSON REST API on servicios.ine.es, including microdata products and SDG (Agenda 2030) indicators.

name: Go-Goal
description: 朝阳永续 Go-Goal is a Chinese financial data platform known for consensus estimates and earnings indicator databases.

name: Our World in Data
description: Our World in Data is Global Change Data Lab’s public catalog of research indicators and charts on global development, health, energy, and environment. The catalog UI is ourworldindata.org. Do not re-add the hub or add every chart URL. Distinct from Gapminder (WordPress data-download page) and from World Bank / WHO source hubs that OWID cites.

name: Wind Economic Database
description: 万得 (Wind) is the dominant Chinese financial data terminal; its EDB economic database provides millions of macro, industry and financial indicator series.

name: R Shiny
description: Shiny is an R web-application framework (Posit, formerly RStudio) used to build interactive statistical tools. Statistics agencies and health observatories deploy Shiny apps (self-hosted or on shinyapps.io) as indicator dashboards and statistical query applications.

name: LeadLeo
description: 头豹研究院 LeadLeo is an industry research platform with Chinese industry indicator dashboards.

name: IBIS-PH
description: IBIS-PH (Indicator-Based Information System for Public Health) is an open-source platform developed by U.S. state health departments to publish indicator reports and run real-time queries against public health datasets. Deployments share XML-driven indicator pages, IBIS-Q query modules, and a community-of-practice codebase.

name: UN Comtrade Plus
description: UN Comtrade Plus is the United Nations Statistics Division’s merchandise trade statistics database. The public catalog UI is comtradeplus.un.org. The machine API is on comtradeapi.un.org and typically needs a subscription key. Do not re-add the hub. Distinct from WITS (World Bank), UNCTADstat, and UNdata.

name: eDatos
description: eDatos is an open-source statistical data and metadata infrastructure started by ISTAC (Canary Islands) and reused by other Spanish regional statistical institutes. Public tenants expose JSON-stat indicator APIs under /indicators/v1.0/ plus e-Cubos / ODS catalog UIs, often on *.edatos.io.

name: DGBAS Web
description: DGBAS Web is Taiwan's local-government statistical query platform (資料庫查詢平臺), distributed by the Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics under the WINSTA programme. Public tenants use /DgbasWeb/ (index.aspx or Default.aspx) on {org}.dgbas.gov.tw or a municipal host. Distinct from WebMain (`webmain`, nstatdb.dgbas.gov.tw/dgbasall and ministry webMain.aspx clones) and from county PxWeb sites.

owner.name: Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics

name: MacroChina Database
description: 中宏数据库 is the statistical database of the China Macroeconomic Information Network, covering macroeconomic and regional indicators.

name: BIS Data Portal
description: The BIS Data Portal provides access to statistical and financial indicators published by the Bank for International Settlements, with interactive exploration and machine-readable SDMX/JSON endpoints for programmatic use.

name: Envista Web
description: Envista Web is Envitech Ltd's public publisher for air-quality and environmental monitoring networks managed in Envista ARM. Agency sites serve station maps, measurements, and reports. Distinct from the Envista ARM desktop client, from generic Kendo UI applications, and from one-off air-quality dashboards.

name: SORMAS
description: SORMAS (Surveillance, Outbreak Response Management and Analysis System) is an open-source digital health platform for disease surveillance and outbreak response, maintained by the SORMAS Foundation. National deployments (Nepal, Ghana, Nigeria, Fiji, and others) are operated by ministries of health; some publish an anonymous public dashboard or bulletin with weekly counts of outbreak-prone diseases by province, district, and municipality.
capabilities: Weekly disease counts by administrative unit

name: IMF National Summary Data Page
description: The IMF National Summary Data Page (NSDP) is the standardized e-GDDS, SDDS, and SDDS Plus dissemination template that national statistical offices and central banks host. Pages list macroeconomic categories with SDMX 2.0 XML downloads and a link to the IMF Dissemination Standards Bulletin Board. Distinct from Knoema or WordPress sites that only wrap an NSDP.

name: BOOST
description: BOOST is the World Bank open-budget program and fiscal transparency portal platform, launched in 2010 with active engagements in over 90 developing countries. Country ministries of finance publish line-item expenditure and revenue data extracted from government financial management information systems through country-owned BOOST web portals with interactive pivot tables and CSV/Excel downloads. Registry installations include Paraguay (boostvep.mef.gov.py), Cameroon (boostcameroon.cm), Mauritania (boost.budget.mr), and Tunisia (Mizaniatouna).
capabilities: Line-item government expenditure and revenue pivot tables
Budget classification by administrative, economic, functional, and program categories
Cross-country comparative fiscal indicators (BOOST data lab)

description: Apache Superset is an open-source data exploration and visualization platform for building interactive dashboards, charts, and SQL-based analytics over connected datasets.
name: Apache Superset
Huaon
description: 华经情报网 Huaon is an industry research portal publishing Chinese industry statistics and market indicators.

name: SDG Index
description: SDG Index dashboards are the Sustainable Development Solutions Network (SDSN) indicator sites for the Sustainable Development Report and regional or subnational editions. Current hosts are Next.js apps, usually on *.sdgindex.org, with rankings, maps, profiles, and a downloadable indicator database. The 2019 European Cities edition is an earlier static build on euro-cities.sdgindex.org. Country profile pages on the same host are not separate catalogs. Do not label OpenSDG sites or the SDSN library at sdgtransformationcenter.org.

name: Swing
description: Swing (ABF Research) is a statistical databank and dashboard platform used by Dutch and Flemish municipalities and provinces. Flemish public tenants live at {city}.incijfers.be and provincies.incijfers.be (Swing Viewer / Swing Jive). Harvest indicator tables, not map tiles.

name: CNKI Economic and Social Big Data Research Platform
description: 中国经济社会大数据研究平台 is CNKI's statistical data platform, digitizing thousands of Chinese statistical yearbooks into searchable indicator tables.

name: Feigua
description: 飞瓜数据 Feigua publishes short-video and livestream commerce metrics.

name: GeCO-sys OpenData
description: GeCO-sys OpenData is a web application used by Italian cancer registries to publish epidemiological indicators computed from AIRTUM record-layout archives. Public tenants live on gecoopendata.{registry-host} with /incidenza.php, /sopravvivenza.php, and related statistic pages on an AdminBSB-based UI with GeCOsys branding, covering incidence, mortality, survival, prevalence, and data-quality indicators by tumour site, age, sex, and territory. Documented as a reusable application by the Registro Tumori Veneto; tenants include the Veneto, Umbria, and ASL Napoli 3 Sud registries. Distinct from GeCo, the Lombardy regional-council management application.

name: Bosidata
description: 博思数据 Bosidata is an industry data and market research portal publishing Chinese market indicators.

name: SparkMap
description: SparkMap is a community mapping and assessment platform from the Center for Applied Research and Engagement Systems (CARES) at the University of Missouri. Public Map Room instances expose tens of thousands of indicator layers; branded CARES hubs add community needs assessment reports. A paid REST API provides programmatic access to premium indicators.

owner.name: Center for Applied Research and Engagement Systems, University of Missouri Extension

name: CEIC Data
description: CEIC is a global macroeconomic data platform with deep China coverage, offering curated indicator series with public indicator pages and subscription access.

name: Géoclip
description: Géoclip (current generation Géoclip Air) is a commercial geostatistical observatory platform from Business Geografic (Ciril GROUP). Public tenants publish interactive indicator maps, tables, charts, and territory reports, often under /geoclip/, /geoclipair/, /atlas/, or a branded host. Distinct from Articque Platform / Cartes & Données and from INSEE or ANCT CMS pages that only mention Géoclip.

name: DUVA
description: DUVA is a metadata-based municipal statistics information system from the German KOSIS-Gemeinschaft DUVA. The public catalog surface is the Informationsportal (tables, charts, and maps generated from DUVA metadata), typically under /Informationsportal/ or a branded FR.ITZ-style host. About 60 German cities and counties use the community software. Distinct from Korean KOSIS (kosis.kr) and from Urban Audit atlas hosts that do not expose a public Informationsportal.

name: Virtual LMI
description: Virtual LMI (VLMI) is Geographic Solutions’ labor market information module, often hosted at *.virtuallmi.com with a /vosnet/ UI. US state workforce agencies publish LAUS, QCEW, OEWS, projections, and area profiles. Do not label every state LMI site VLMI — confirm virtuallmi.com or /vosnet/.

name: GSData
description: 清博智能 GSData publishes WeChat/Weibo social-media account metrics and rankings.

name: StatPlanet
description: StatPlanet (StatSilk) is interactive mapping and dashboard software for exploring statistical indicators on maps and charts. Public deployments include StatPlanet Cloud (HTML5, data.csv / settings.csv, optional SDMX) and older StatPlanet HTML5/Flash maps. Use this id only for a public indicator explorer, not a vendor demo, a single-map poster, or a viewer of another registered catalog.

name: Qianzhan Database
description: 前瞻数据库 is Qianzhan's industry data portal publishing Chinese macro and industry economic indicator tables.

name: DesInventar
description: DesInventar is the disaster loss and damage database methodology and software coordinated by UNDRR. National institutions build country inventories of disaster events with homogeneous event, cause, damage, and loss classification; the DesInventar Sendai web system at desinventar.net hosts national datasets used for Sendai Framework and SDG target monitoring. Installations include national systems such as Cambodia's CamDi.

owner.name: United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR)

capabilities: National disaster loss and damage inventories
Homogeneous event, cause, and effect classification
Sendai Framework target indicators and SDG monitoring

name: Cascade CMS
description: Cascade CMS is Hannon Hill's web content management system used by US state agencies and universities to publish data and indicator portals. Published pages carry Cascade template-region comments such as `<system-region name="CAROUSEL"/>`. State labor market information sites on Cascade (for example milmi.org, lmi.mt.gov, discover.arkansas.gov) share a common `_files/css` + `_files/js` asset layout with news-gallery.js and random-background.js. Data applications inside the CMS (data searches, dashboards) are site-custom.

name: StatsWales
description: StatsWales is the Welsh Government's official statistics dissemination service. The bilingual catalog UI lives on statswales.gov.wales and the public API (OAS 3.1) on api.stats.gov.wales (/v1 lists all published datasets). One national hub — do not add a catalog per topic or per dataset. Distinct from the retired OData service (open.statswales.gov.wales, shut down August 2024) and from InfoBaseCymru local authority profiles.

name: Baiinfo
description: 百川盈孚 Baiinfo publishes Chinese commodity market data and price indicators.

name: EPS Data Platform
description: EPS 数据平台 is a commercial statistical database platform licensed to Chinese universities and libraries, offering macro, regional, industry and trade statistics with a web indicator browser.

name: InstantAtlas
description: InstantAtlas is Esri UK’s geostatistical atlas/report publisher (formerly GeoWise). Public catalogs are HTML5 InstantAtlas™ reports (ia-min.js or ia-max.js, iaInitReport, footer Powered By InstantAtlas™, title InstantAtlas™ Bericht/Rapport) or InstantAtlas Dashboard Builder views on dashboards.instantatlas.com. Distinct from Esri UK Data Observatory (esridataobservatory, WordPress ia-theme local-information portals) and from Report Builder for ArcGIS.

name: Global Cancer Observatory
description: The Global Cancer Observatory (GCO) is the IARC/WHO cancer indicators platform, hosting the Cancer Today (GLOBOCAN incidence, mortality, and prevalence estimates), Cancer Tomorrow, and Cancer Over Time tools. It is served on the mirrored hosts gco.iarc.fr and gco.iarc.who.int, with country, cancer type, age, and sex breakdowns, charts, maps, and downloadable tables.

owner.name: International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC/WHO)

name: RESSET
description: 锐思数据 RESSET is an academic research data platform for Chinese financial and economic indicator series.

name: Sunsirs (100ppi)
description: 生意社 Sunsirs (100ppi.com) publishes Chinese commodity price indices across energy, metals, chemicals and agriculture.

name: China Data Online
description: China Data Online (All China Data Center) is the University of Michigan platform providing Chinese statistical yearbooks, census and GIS indicators to universities.

owner.name: China Data Center, University of Michigan

name: Nomis
description: Nomis is the official UK labour market and census statistics service, provided by the Office for National Statistics and run under contract by Durham University. The catalog UI and the REST/SDMX API live on www.nomisweb.co.uk (dataset list at /api/v01/dataset/def.sdmx.json). One national hub — do not add a catalog per dataset or per geography. Distinct from the ONS website (ons.gov.uk), NISRA and StatsWales products, and from Power BI or InstantAtlas labour-market dashboards.

name: ECB Data Portal
description: The ECB Data Portal is the European Central Bank's official platform for accessing macroeconomic, financial, and statistical indicators, with support for interactive exploration and SDMX-based data access.

name: IHK-Fachkräftemonitor
description: IHK-Fachkräftemonitor is a multi-Land labour-market dashboard used by German Chambers of Industry and Commerce. Public tenants share ihk-fachkraeftemonitor.de/{land}/ (for example /bw/, /nrw/, /sh/) with occupation, industry, and regional skills-shortage projections. The underlying model is from GWS Osnabrück. Distinct from IHK Arbeitsmarktradar Bayern and IHK-Konjunkturboard.

name: MATS
description: MATS (Modernes Analyse Tool Statistik) is the shared statistical data-warehouse and dashboard product co-developed by Statistikamt Nord, Statistisches Landesamt Rheinland-Pfalz, and Amt für Statistik Berlin-Brandenburg. Public catalogs are the Land MATS-Datenportal pages of filterable tables and dashboards (Oracle Analytics underneath). Distinct from GENESIS-Online, from SIS-Dashboards, and from generic Oracle APEX sites.

owner.name: Statistikamt Nord / Statistisches Landesamt Rheinland-Pfalz / Amt für Statistik Berlin-Brandenburg

description: PX-Web is a statistical data dissemination software used to publish and explore multidimensional statistics online, with support for tabular browsing, API access, and standard statistical exchange formats.
name: PxWeb
Eurostat
description: Eurostat is the statistical office of the European Union and provides official European statistics through datasets, indicators, and interactive data access services.

name: DataYes
description: 通联数据萝卜投研 DataYes is a quant-oriented Chinese data platform with macro and industry indicator databases.

name: FENIX
description: FENIX is FAO's open-source statistical dissemination platform (Dynamic Data Dissemination System / D3S). CountrySTAT national agriculture-statistics portals, FAOSTAT, AMIS, AIDmonitor, and related FAO indicator UIs were built on it. REST APIs are typically on fenixservices.fao.org (for example FAOSTAT /faostat/api/v1/).

owner.name: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations

name: iResearch
description: 艾瑞咨询 iResearch is an internet industry research platform publishing Chinese online advertising and e-commerce indicators.

name: Jinlianchuang (315i)
description: 金联创 Jinlianchuang (315i.com) publishes Chinese bulk commodity pricing and market indicators.

name: FPMA Tool
description: The Food Price Monitoring and Analysis (FPMA) Tool is FAO GIEWS' indicator dashboard for domestic and international food prices. Version 4 (fpmat4) runs a global instance at fpma.fao.org and country instances hosted by FAO or national statistical offices and ministries of agriculture (for example Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan, El Salvador, Guatemala, Yemen, Costa Rica, Zimbabwe). Each instance publishes monthly price series by country, market, and commodity with charts, maps, and CSV/Excel downloads.

owner.name: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations

capabilities: Price time series charts and maps

name: e-Stat
description: e-Stat is Japan’s portal site for official statistics (政府統計の総合窓口). Public catalogs include the table portal (www.e-stat.go.jp), Statistical LOD (data.e-stat.go.jp), and the Statistics Dashboard (dashboard.e-stat.go.jp). The machine API is api.e-stat.go.jp and requires an application ID. Distinct from RESAS and from ministry CMS pages that only link to e-Stat.

name: Gildata
description: 恒生聚源 Gildata is Hundsun's financial data service providing Chinese macro, market and company indicator databases.

name: iiMedia Data Center
description: 艾媒数据中心 iiMedia is a new-economy market research platform publishing Chinese consumer and internet industry indicators.

name: CNRDS
description: 中国研究数据服务平台 CNRDS is an academic research data platform for Chinese economic and financial studies.

name: SCI99
description: 卓创资讯 SCI99 publishes Chinese commodity price monitoring across hundreds of products.

name: Microsoft SharePoint
description: Microsoft SharePoint is an enterprise content and intranet platform. Several ministries, central banks, and statistics offices publish their statistics pages and indicator sections on public SharePoint sites rather than dedicated data platforms. Spanish ministry sedes and some university open-data catalogs are the same platform (`/_layouts/`, `.aspx`).

name: TerriSTORY
description: TerriSTORY is an open-source territorial energy, climate, and environmental-transition platform (aGPL-v3) developed by a French regional consortium led by AURA-EE. Public regional hubs live at terristory.fr/{region} with indicator maps, dashboards, and prospective scenarios. One catalog per regional hub with its own governance, not each commune or each indicator.

name: Fusion Data Browser
description: Fusion Data Browser is Metadata Technology's SDMX dissemination UI. It browses dataflows, builds tables and charts, and exports CSV, Excel, and SDMX. Public installs are usually mounted at /FusionDataBrowser and read a Fusion Edge Server or Fusion Registry data API (/FusionEdgeServer/ws/public/sdmxapi/rest or /FusionEdgeServer/sdmx/v2/). One record per public browser. Structural registries without this UI stay fusionregistry.
Open SDG is an open-source platform for publishing Sustainable Development Goal indicators as a web-based reporting portal with data uploads, indicator pages, charts, and downloadable resources.
name: OpenSDG
BI Contour
description: BI Contour is a business intelligence platform for interactive reporting and data analysis. It includes visualization, publishing, and OLAP capabilities and is used to build analytical portals and dashboards for large datasets.

name: SOPORTAL
description: SOPORTAL is Wiseitech's agency statistical-table portal for South Korean public authorities. Tenants share indexPage.do, a /css/{skin}/soportal/ stylesheet tree, /js/portal/lib/, and /portal/stat/ table browsers (easyStatPage.do, orgStatPage.do, nameStatPage.do), mounted under a context path such as /portal/, /research/portal/, or /r-one/portal/. OpenAPI pages live under /portal/openapi/ and require a service key. commonness.js carries COPYRIGHT (C) 2013 WISEITECH CO., LTD., but that file also ships on unrelated Wiseitech sites (Gyeonggi Data Dream, Open National Assembly) that use mainPage.do. Distinct from KOSIS /statHtml/statHtml.do, from MOLIT 통계누리, and from IBSheet used as a grid on other statistical sites.

name: WHO Data
description: The World Health Organization data services provide global health indicators, statistics, and monitoring data through web interfaces and APIs for countries and thematic programs.

Semantic MediaWiki is an open-source extension of MediaWiki that enables structured data modeling, semantic annotation, querying, and export from wiki content. It is used to build knowledge-driven data catalogs and portals with machine-readable metadata.
name: Semantic MediaWiki
Ísland.is
description: Ísland.is is the open-source digital-services platform of the Icelandic government (Stafrænt Ísland / Digital Iceland), developed as a public MIT-licensed TypeScript monorepo. Government content catalogs such as the Stjórnartíðindi official gazette and the Opin gögn open-data page are published as Ísland.is applications. A GraphQL gateway at api.island.is fronts the underlying REST microservices, and machine-to-machine services are registered in the X-Road Straumurinn API catalogue. Distinct from the national CKAN catalog on ckan.island.is (ckan).

name: ATM Maggioli
description: ATM Maggioli (Galileo IyS) Portal de Transparencia is a Spanish municipal electronic-office and open-data catalog used on sede electrónica tenants. Deployments share /transparencia/datos/catalogo dataset listings for local reuse.

name: Plone
description: Plone is an open-source content management system on Zope. Use this id for catalog records whose site runs on Plone (generator meta "Plone - http://plone.org", portal_css, Zope ZServer). Ordinary Plone homepages without a data catalog function are out of scope.
Open Data Registry is an open-source metadata registry for publishing and discovering open datasets, with machine-readable catalog files and optional STAC-compatible endpoints.
name: Open Data Registry

description: uData is an open-source data portal platform for publishing and managing datasets, organizations, and resources with a REST API and DCAT-compatible metadata export.
name: uData
openportal
description: openportal is a Chinese government open-data portal product that serves the catalog under /extranet/openportal/pages/... . Observed on independent municipal hosts in two provinces — Yichun, Jiangxi (data.yichun.gov.cn) and Zhangjiakou, Hebei (kf.zjkzwfw.gov.cn). Distinct from Inspur oPortal (`oportal`), Zhejiang JDOP (`jdop`), and ODWeb (`odweb`).

name: Liferay
description: Liferay is an open-source digital experience and content management platform used for government and municipal websites. Spanish provincial deployments expose an Open Data / RISP module that lists reusable municipal datasets as Excel, XML, JSON, and CSV exports.

name: data eye
description: data eye is a Japanese open data portal SaaS from Data Cradle. Prefectures and municipalities use it to register, publish, and share catalogs, including group portals for joint prefecture-municipality publishing and a CKAN-compatible metadata API.

name: Gobierto Datos
description: Gobierto Datos is the open-data catalog module of Gobierto, the municipal open-government platform from Populate Tools. Each administration gets a hosted site with a dataset hub at /datos/, DCAT metadata, CSV/JSON/XML downloads, and a SQL API over HTTP. The same suite also ships budget, contracts, and transparency modules; those pages are not this catalog. Source is at github.com/PopulateTools/gobierto. Populate also offers it as SaaS.

name: OpenAIRE
description: OpenAIRE is a scholarly discovery and monitoring platform built on the OpenAIRE Graph. EXPLORE is the public search interface; CONNECT is a hosted gateway service used for national and community research portals that filter the Graph by organisation, funder, or country.

name: D4Science
description: D4Science is a European digital research infrastructure that provides virtual research environments, data management, and analytics services for collaborative open science workflows across disciplines. It offers integrated tools for data publishing, storage, and processing as a not-for-profit platform.

name: OGD Platform India
description: Open Government Data (OGD) Platform India is the National Informatics Centre SaaS used to publish and discover public-sector datasets. Ministries and state governments run dedicated data.gov.in instances with catalog search, downloads, and APIs.

name: Joomla
description: Joomla is an open-source PHP content management system. Use this id for catalog or portal records whose site runs on Joomla (generator meta "Joomla! - Open Source Content Management", /media/, /components/com_* asset paths), the same convention as wordpress and liferay. Ordinary Joomla homepages without a data or map catalog function are out of scope.

name: Taiji Digital Public Data Open Platform
description: Commercial public-data open platform from Taiji Digital (深圳太极数智技术有限公司), branded 太极数智公共数据开放平台. The product page cites Shenzhen (opendata.sz.gov.cn). Live shells serve /static/opendata1.0/ and do not print the vendor name. Not Inspur oPortal and not Epoint.

name: Esri UK Data Observatory
description: Managed local-information and open-data publishing service from Esri UK, formerly branded InstantAtlas Data Observatory. Combines a reusable WordPress theme, the National Data Service, Data Explorer, geographic profiles, and reporting applications backed by ArcGIS. Documented deployments include Suffolk and Hounslow. Distinct from a generic WordPress site or ArcGIS Hub.

name: oPortal
description: oPortal is a Chinese public-data open-platform product used by provincial and municipal governments. Deployments share an /oportal/ catalog, developer center, data services, and application gallery for publishing government datasets and APIs.

name: Azure API Management
description: Microsoft Azure API Management developer portal. Each installation lists APIs with documentation and subscription signup. Catalog records use catalog_type API Catalog. The software category is Open data portal because the software schema has no API Catalog category. Register each public developer portal, not each API operation.
Socrata is a proprietary open data platform for publishing and managing government datasets with catalog search, APIs, and machine-readable metadata exports.
name: Socrata
SIMAI Open Data Portal
description: Commercial ready-to-install open-data portal application for 1C-Bitrix. Publishes dataset descriptions, online tables and downloadable files. Distinct from generic Bitrix; the vendor-operated Bashkortostan-branded demonstration is not a production regional catalog.

PublishMyData is a linked data publishing platform designed for government and official statistics teams to publish, manage, and serve structured data on the web using semantic web standards and APIs.
name: PublishMyData
ResourceContracts
description: ResourceContracts is NRGI's open-source repository of oil, gas, and mining contracts, also deployed as country portals (for example guinea.resourcecontracts.org). Laravel application with a public contract API.

name: jig.jp Open Data Platform
description: Hosted Japanese municipal open-data platform from B Inc. (jig.jp). Subscribers publish into one shared CKAN catalog at ckan.odp.jig.jp, where each local government is an organization. status_show lists a custom extension named odp. The product site also advertises Linked RDF and a SPARQL endpoint.

OutSystems is a proprietary low-code application platform used to build and run web and mobile applications, including government statistics portals and open data catalogs. Each installation exposes bespoke endpoints rather than a standard catalog API.
name: OutSystems
Aid Management Platform
description: The Aid Management Platform (AMP) is Development Gateway's open-source aid-information system. Country installations publish official development assistance activities with public reports, charts, and maps. One record per country portal, not per report or dashboard.

name: Viavansi Open Government
description: Viavansi Open Government is a Spanish municipal open-data front end built as a WordPress theme (viavansi-open-government or viavansi-ogov-current) over a dataset catalog. Public installs include Diputación de Cádiz and Santander. The public page generator is WordPress. Use this id when that theme is the catalog. A bare WordPress open-data page without the Viavansi theme stays wordpress. Do not set ckan unless the public catalog UI is CKAN.

name: JDOP
description: JDOP is the Zhejiang public-data open platform product. Provincial and municipal deployments share a /jdop_front/ or /dopServer/ catalog (浙江•数据开放) used by Zhejiang province, Hangzhou, Wenzhou, and Jinhua for publishing government datasets and APIs.

name: Taiwan Government Website Open Data
description: ASP.NET open-data module on Taiwan local-government websites. Dataset pages are OpenDataList.aspx, with detail pages OpenDataDetail.aspx or OpenDataContent.aspx, and file downloads through OpenDataFileHit.ashx. Distinct from the MODA Nuxt platform (modaopendata). A county homepage or Default.aspx path without those pages is not this product.

name: Gosweb
description: Gosweb is the Gosuslugi website constructor for Russian state and municipal bodies. Public pages load assets from static.gosweb.gosuslugi.ru/omsu/ and the NetCat template gw_omsu (/netcat_template/template/gw_omsu/). Open data is published at /ofitsialno/statistika/otkrytye-dannye/ with list.csv and meta.csv passports. A NetCat site that does not use the gw_omsu template is not Gosweb. esnsi.gosuslugi.ru is a separate reference-data system.

owner.name: Ministry of Digital Development of the Russian Federation

name: Our Open Data
description: Our Open Data is the Japanese open-data catalog UI of the SHIRASAGI CMS (ss-proj.org), used by Tokushima, Kagawa, Aomori, Tottori, Shizuoka, Ehime, and Kakegawa. Deployments share /assets/cms/public.css, jPlayer, numeric /dataset/{n}.html pages, a three-part layout of data catalog, application market, and idea box, and a SHIRASAGI /api/package_list API. Distinct from CKAN (/api/3/action/status_show) and data.go.jp.

name: Contrataciones Abiertas
description: Contrataciones Abiertas is INAI's EDCA-MX capture and public dashboard for open contracting. Installs serve /contratacionesabiertas/datosabiertos on Express, with /contratacionesabiertas/static/javascripts/common.js pointing at the capture API ({url}:{port}/edca/recordPackages/{year}). Distinct from other OCDS portals, including Peru's OECE site, and from pages that only mention the contracting standard.

owner.name: Instituto Nacional de Transparencia, Acceso a la Información y Protección de Datos Personales (INAI)

name: OPENDATAENTE
description: OPENDATAENTE is Actainfo’s cloud SaaS open-data catalog for Italian municipalities and local authorities. Tenants use a React “Portale Open Data” UI and publish DCAT-AP_IT RDF at /backend/api/catalog/ for harvest into dati.gov.it.

name: Epoint Big Data Open Platform
description: Commercial public-data open platform from Epoint (国泰新点软件股份有限公司), branded 新点大数据开放平台. Deployments serve the catalog under /extranet/openportal/ on the agency host. Confirm the product name or an epoint.com.cn application asset; the path alone is not sufficient.

Government Site Builder (GSB) is the central content management system of the German federal administration, provided by ITZBund. More than 80 federal agencies run over 250 websites on it, including statistics, health reporting, and data publication pages. GSB 11 is based on the open-source CMS TYPO3; earlier versions were built on CoreMedia.
name: Government Site Builder
Guangxi Public Data Open Platform
description: The Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region public data open platform hosts the provincial catalog at data.gxzf.gov.cn and city tenants at {city}.data.gxzf.gov.cn. Custom stack (not CKAN) built for five-level public-data opening. One record per tenant, not per dataset.

owner.name: Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Big Data Development Bureau

name: Oraș Digital
description: Oraș Digital is a Romanian municipal open-data portal product (oras.digital, "Connecting the City through technology") deployed per city as {city}.oras.digital with the sister city-app {city}.digital. The Iași deployment (iasi.oras.digital, alias opendata.oras.digital) is a Cloudflare-hosted shell (assets/js/app.min.js, assets/css/app.css) whose dataset pages group records into real-time, statistical, and map categories with institution and format filters (HTML, CSV, XLS, XLSX, API). A REST JSON API is documented per deployment at /api-docs/ with a downloadable Postman collection (assets/api/api-postman-collection.json).

name: Datasette
description: Datasette is an open-source tool for exploring and publishing SQLite databases as an interactive website and JSON/CSV API. Independent instances are common in journalism, government, and research. Register the published instance root, not each table or canned query.

name: Budeshi
description: Budeshi is an open contracting data platform by the Public and Private Development Centre (PPDC, Nigeria). It hosts government procurement portals that publish projects, tenders, and awards as Open Contracting Data Standard (OCDS) releases, with documented HTTP APIs (e.g. /api and /ocds-api on the Kaduna State deployment). Installations carry a "Powered By Budeshi" credit. Use this id for Budeshi-hosted portals; unrelated one-off OCDS portals without the credit stay custom.

name: Datadex
description: Datadex is Datonic's open-source pattern for a serverless, local-first open data portal. A community keeps pipelines in git and publishes static Parquet or CSV tables, often listed on the portal and hosted at data.{host} or on Hugging Face. Register the public portal that lists those tables. Do not register datadex.datonic.io, the GitHub template, or a Hugging Face organization whose datasets already sit in the Hugging Face Datasets catalog.
WordPress is an open-source content management system widely used to build websites, including open data portals via custom themes, plugins, and API-driven integrations.
name: WordPress
SEU-e
description: SEU-e is the Consorci AOC electronic office, transparency, and open data service for Catalan public administrations. Municipalities publish shared open-data pages under seu-e.cat with common dataset listings for local reuse.

name: OpenGDC
description: OpenGDC is an open-source Dutch municipal data catalog (Drupal / Dexes) for datasets, APIs, and Wet open overheid dossiers. It publishes DCAT-AP metadata and a JSON:API catalog, and registers with data.overheid.nl. Distinct from the genomic OpenGDC extraction tool.

Tablion Data Portal is a commercial open data portal product by Aristotle Metadata that supports publishing, discovery, and metadata exchange for datasets through web interfaces and standards-based exports.
name: Tablion
OneGov Election Day
description: OneGov Election Day is the open-source elections and votes application in OneGov Cloud (Seantis). Swiss cantons and communes publish result tables, JSON and CSV downloads, and a DCAT-AP CH catalog at /catalog.rdf for opendata.swiss. Distinct from Tyler OpenGov (opengov) financial transparency on opengov.com.

name: CKAN
description: CKAN is an open-source data management system for publishing, sharing, and using data. It powers hundreds of public open data portals and internal data hubs with datasets, organizations, resources, a rich Action API, and an extensible plugin ecosystem (including DCAT and OAI-PMH).

Strapi is an open-source headless CMS platform used to model, manage, and deliver structured content and data through customizable APIs. It supports flexible content types, role-based access control, and extensible integrations for public sector and open data publishing workflows.
name: Strapi
Seoul Open Data Plaza
description: Seoul Open Data Plaza is the shared open-data catalog used by Seoul Metropolitan Government district (gu) portals. Tenant sites share /openinf/ JSP pages, the jachigu theme, dataset listings, and Open API developer space, with titles of the form 열린 데이터 광장.

name: LKOD
description: LKOD (Lokální katalog otevřených dat) is an open-source local open-data catalog from Golemio / Operátor ICT. It implements DCAT-AP-CZ, harvests into the Czech National Open Data Catalog (NKOD), and is deployed as Next.js catalogs on lkod.cz or self-hosted instances for Czech public bodies.

JKAN is an open-source, lightweight data catalog platform built on Jekyll for publishing open datasets as static sites. It focuses on simple deployment, CKAN-style metadata patterns, and optional API compatibility for small and medium open data portals.
name: JKAN

description: Magda is an open-source data catalog and discovery platform for publishing, searching, and reusing open data. It provides configurable dataset metadata, organization support, and API-driven integrations for government and institutional data portals.

owner.name: Queensland Government Customer and Digital Group

name: Magda

description: OpenDataSoft is a software platform for publishing, managing, and sharing open data portals with dataset cataloging, APIs, and data visualization features for public and private organizations. Some statistical portals, including Banque de France Webstat, use the same platform as an indicators catalog.
name: OpenDataSoft
PA-Online Open Data
description: PA-Online Open Data is the hosted DCAT catalog Technical Design publishes for Italian municipalities on pa-online.it. Each comune is a directory under /OpenData/{ISTAT code}/ with an RDF catalog (METADATO.rdf or a comune-named .rdf) that dati.gov.it harvests. The same host serves GisMasterWebS sportello and payment pages; those are not this catalog, and the map viewer remains gismaster.

name: PortalJS
description: PortalJS is Datopian's open-data catalog frontend. Governments and other organizations publish a dataset catalog on their own host, often with the footer "PortalJS on CKAN Backend". Dataset pages use /@{org}/{slug}. Hosted portals also run on {slug}.portaljs.com and {slug}.arc.portaljs.com. A CKAN Action API on the same host or a linked API host does not make the public catalog plain CKAN.
Drupal is an open-source content management framework used to build and manage websites, including open data portals through dedicated modules, metadata extensions, and API integrations.
name: Drupal
Open Data Euskadi
description: Open Data Euskadi is the Basque Government's own open data portal platform, run on the euskadi.eus web stack. The catalog publishes datasets in Basque, Spanish and English, exposes a documented custom REST API (JSON/XML) plus a SPARQL endpoint on api.euskadi.eus, and federates DCAT metadata to datos.gob.es.

name: POMOSAM
description: POMOSAM (CG eGOV) is a municipal eGovernment and open data publishing platform by CORA GEO, focused on publishing public city information, contracts, invoices, orders, and enabling citizen online communication with local administration.

name: Gipuzkoa Irekia
description: Gipuzkoa Irekia is the Provincial Council of Gipuzkoa's shared open government and open data platform. Municipalities and foral entities publish datasets on tenant sites with a common catalog, DCAT feeds, and open-data search.

MapaInversiones is the Inter-American Development Bank (IDB) regional platform for public investment transparency, deployed in 14+ Latin American and Caribbean countries (Colombia, Paraguay, Costa Rica, Peru, Dominican Republic, Argentina, Jamaica, Honduras, Panama, and others). A .NET web application that georeferences public investment projects, budgets, and procurement data (using the OCDS standard), with a national open-data download section on each deployment. Since 2025 it is an open-source digital public good distributed through the IDB Code for Development (Code4Dev) catalog. Deployments are often branded "MapaInversiones" nationally, for example Costa Rica's Rendir Cuentas / MapaInversiones at rendircuentas.mideplan.go.cr.
name: MapaInversiones
KUKAN
description: KUKAN (Knowledge Unified Katalog And Network) is an open-source TypeScript data catalog from Info Lounge, built as a CKAN-compatible alternative. It publishes datasets, organizations, groups, and resources, with a native /api/v1 catalog API and CKAN Action API v3 read endpoints.

name: data.gov.my
description: data.gov.my is Malaysia's national open data portal for publishing and discovering public-sector datasets across government domains. It provides dataset search and API-enabled access to structured data resources for reuse by citizens, researchers, and businesses.

owner.name: Malaysian Administrative Modernisation and Management Planning Unit (MAMPU)

name: Idra
description: Idra is an open-source Open Data Federation Platform from Engineering Ingegneria Informatica (FIWARE). It harvests heterogeneous ODMS catalogues (CKAN, DKAN, Socrata, OpenDataSoft, NGSI, DCAT-AP dumps, and scraped sites), harmonizes metadata to DCAT-AP / DCAT-AP_IT, and exposes a search portal, REST API, and SPARQL endpoint.

name: Het Dataloket
description: Het Dataloket is Analyze's hosted catalog of data assets for Dutch governments (datasets, maps, dashboards, and reports). Public tenants are a Vue SPA titled "Dataportaal", with /assets/img/search-blue.svg and /assets/img/logo_analyze.svg, configuration at /api/configuration, and catalog search at /api/search. Known hosts include data.venlo.nl, dataportaal.tilburg.nl, and dataportaal.prvlimburg.nl. One record per tenant. Distinct from Civity CKAN at ckan.dataplatform.nl, Swing incijfers sites, and the separate Limburg viewer at dataportaal-viewer.prvlimburg.nl.

name: CreatorCMS
description: CreatorCMS is a Chinese government website CMS whose data-open module serves municipal data catalogs under /webapp/{city}/... (dataPublic/index.jsp, dataDetail.jsp?id=), with KCUI front-end assets and /creatorCMS/ backend routes. Observed on Hunan municipal portals (Yiyang, Chenzhou, Yueyang). Vendor attribution is inferred from the KCUI/creatorCMS fingerprints.

name: MODA Open Data Platform
description: MODA Open Data Platform is the open-source Nuxt/Vue frontend for Taiwan's government open-data catalogs. The Ministry of Digital Affairs publishes moda-gov-tw/opendata-frontend; national data.gov.tw and local platforms such as New Taipei and Taipei reuse the same _nuxt stack and catalog API.

name: Bon Maximus e-Procurement
description: Bon Maximus e-Procurement is a vendor-built electronic government procurement and open contracting portal by Bon Maximus Companies Ltd (Abuja, Nigeria). Deployments power Nigerian state Bureau of Public Procurement portals (e.g. Kogi, Osun, Abia, Ebonyi, Anambra) that publish tender and award records and OCDS-oriented pages. Installations are IIS-hosted ASP.NET sites with a "Powered by Bon Maximus Companies" footer credit. Use this id for the vendor product; one-off e-procurement sites without the Bon Maximus credit stay custom.

name: GIS Open Data Portal
description: Shared municipal open-data application deployed for Tvrdošín and Nové Mesto nad Váhom on twinmap.ai. Both deployments identify the gis-open-data-portal/od-portal source project and provide the same REST feature API, GraphQL interface, CSV downloads, and DCAT-AP-SK catalog. The advertised source repository currently requires sign-in; its license and software vendor have not been verified.

1C-Bitrix is a commercial web content management and portal platform used to build government and enterprise websites, including open data publication pages and catalog sections. It provides extensible modules, role-based administration, and API integration capabilities for publishing structured content and datasets.
name: Bitrix
OpenSpending
description: OpenSpending is Open Knowledge Foundation's open-source platform for publishing and exploring public-finance and government-budget datasets as Fiscal Data Packages, with a public search UI and API.

name: Anhui open-data-web
description: Anhui open-data-web is a Chinese public-data open platform product deployed in Anhui province. Deployments serve the catalog under /open-data-web/ with Struts-style .do actions (Bozhou, Hefei) or /dataopen-web/ (provincial host data.ahzwfw.gov.cn). Distinct from Inspur oPortal (`oportal`), Zhejiang JDOP (`jdop`), ODWeb (`odweb`), and Guangxi gxopendata.

name: RDF Online Repository
description: The Online Repository is Revenue Development Foundation's public transparency portal for mining and other license registries. Country tenants are hosted on *.revenuedev.org and publish from MCAS/xCAS via the RDx REST exchange. Distinct from W3C RDF.

EKAN is an open-source Drupal 9/10 data catalog distribution by Eighty Options. It is the upgrade path for Drupal 7 DKAN 1.0 sites, combining dataset and resource cataloging with a conventional Drupal CMS. Distinct from GetDKAN (software.id dkan), which is a Drupal 8+ rewrite with a decoupled React catalog.
name: EKAN

description: Datawheel is a data platform provider focused on open data portals, economic complexity analytics, and AI-powered data tools for governments and international organizations.
name: DataWheel
LinkData
description: LinkData is Info Lounge’s hosted platform for converting and publishing open tables as reusable datasets. Japanese municipalities and civic projects publish works on the shared hub at linkdata.org. Register that hub once. City homepages that only link to a work, App.LinkData applications, and Idea.LinkData posts are not separate catalogs.

name: Centurion
description: Centurion is the government data-portal platform from PT eBdesk Teknologi. Public shells set theme-fontsize and data-maps on the html element and theme-shape="rounded" on the body. Installations load the Charts module from https://fem.centurion.id/remoteEntry.js or from a same-host /femc/remoteEntry.js that begins with "var Charts". Some tenants also expose a PostGraphile API at POST /api/v1/graphql (metadata_datasets). A satudata hostname alone is not this product. The centurion.id login and fem.centurion.id module host are not catalogs.

name: Squarespace
description: Squarespace is a hosted website builder. Small US research groups and foundations publish data and indicator pages as Squarespace sites (for example Kentucky Health Facts, Freedom on the Move, SAIS CARI Data). Signals are the Server Squarespace response header, static1.squarespace.com assets, and end-of-squarespace-headers HTML comments. Dataset tables and downloads are ordinary Squarespace pages.

name: Municipium Portale Opendata
description: Municipium Portale Opendata is the open-data module of the Municipium municipal platform by Maggioli. Italian comuni publish a "Portale Opendata" catalog on their own host (opendata.comune.*.it) backed by the shared opendata-api.cloud.municipiumapp.it service, with a Bootstrap Italia theme, /js/agid-home.js, and the apis.maggioli.cloud captcha widget. Distinct from ATM Maggioli (atmmaggioli), the Spanish sede electrónica product.

name: Felles datakatalog
description: Felles datakatalog (FDK) is the Norwegian Digitalisation Agency's open-source, federated metadata catalog for datasets, data services, concepts, information models, services, and events. It powers data.norge.no and its Transportportal profile, with DCAT-AP-NO, search, RDF, and SPARQL interfaces.
Data Fair is an open-source data platform for managing, visualizing, exploring, and sharing datasets through configurable portals, interactive views, and API-based access.
name: Data Fair

description: TriplyDB is a linked-data and knowledge graph publishing platform used to host, query, and share datasets through SPARQL endpoints, APIs, and reusable data services.
name: TriplyDB
ComunWeb
description: ComunWeb is the Consorzio dei Comuni Trentini website platform used by Trentino municipalities and communities. Each site publishes a dataset list as the content class opendata_dataset (/api/opendata/v1/content/class/opendata_dataset) and a CSV at /exportas/csv/opendata_dataset. The classList endpoint also exposes the rest of the CMS. Register one record per ente site that has that dataset class, not the vendor site comunweb.it. A ckan_ prefix on objectRemoteId is a remote id, not a CKAN portal.

name: Jekyll
description: Jekyll is a static site generator, often hosted on GitHub Pages. Research projects publish dataset catalogs as Jekyll sites (for example Open Graph Benchmark, Therapeutics Data Commons, Gene Ontology, BridgeDb). Signals are the `jekyll-seo-tag` HTML comments and a `Jekyll vX.Y.Z` generator meta. Use `jekyll` only when the data catalog itself is the Jekyll site; do not tag custom repository applications that merely keep a Jekyll docs frame.

Aleph is an open-source investigative data platform for indexing, searching, and cross-referencing large collections of documents and structured datasets. It is designed for investigative journalism workflows and entity-centric research across people, companies, and related records.

owner.name: OCCRP (Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project)

name: Aleph
data.world
description: data.world is a commercial catalog SaaS for open and organization datasets. Register the public hub at data.world, not per-user or per-organization private spaces. Distinct from World Bank Data (dataworldbankorg).

name: OpenGov
description: OpenGov (Tyler Technologies) is a US local-government financial transparency SaaS. Public tenants use {org}.opengov.com with /transparency and /data report views. Distinct from generic sites named OpenGov, wyopen.gov checkbooks, and ArcGIS Hub portals branded as open government.

name: IUDX Catalogue
description: IUDX Catalogue Server is the India Urban Data Exchange catalog software. The national hub is catalogue.iudx.org.in / central-catalogue. Distinct from CKAN and from pygeoapi on other IUDX hosts. Register each public catalogue tenant, not each resource ID.
Junar is a proprietary open data platform for publishing, managing, and sharing datasets through catalog interfaces and APIs for government and enterprise data programs.
name: Junar
BODIK ODCS
description: Hosted open-data catalog for Japanese local governments, run by the Big Data and Open Data Initiative Kyushu (ISIT). Each municipality is a tenant at odcs.bodik.jp/{lgcode}. The shared catalog API is CKAN at data.bodik.jp. A 2020 Docker package (odpkg-docker) bundles CKAN, WordPress, and a map dashboard; live tenants are the hosted service, not that package.

owner.name: Big Data & Open Data Initiative Kyushu

description: EntryScape is a linked-data-based information management platform for publishing and managing open data catalogs across the full metadata lifecycle, with strong support for DCAT-AP standards.
name: EntryScape
DataPortal.AI
description: DataPortal.AI is the Sister (Almawave) open-data portal, the current generation of StatPortal Open Data and SPOD. Italian administrations publish a dataset catalog on their own host. SPOD portals are Drupal 7 with /sites/all/modules/spodata/, a statportal or spod_bootstrap theme, a catalog at /catalogo-opendata or /catalog, and datasets under /opendata/{slug}. The DataPortal.AI shell has title DataPortal.AI and /lmap/lmap-core/. Distinct from the Istat browser at statportal.it, from Sister Data Browser, from StatKit, from CKAN (including a former SPOD host that now returns ckan_version), and from a generic Drupal theme.

name: Copernicus Data Stores
description: Copernicus Data Stores is the ECMWF catalog and retrieve platform used by the Climate Data Store, Atmosphere Data Store, and CEMS Early Warning Data Store. Users search quality-assured climate, atmosphere, and emergency datasets in the web catalog and download them through the CDS API.

owner.name: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF)

description: DKAN is an open-source data management and catalog platform built on Drupal for publishing, discovering, and reusing open data. It supports dataset metadata, organizations, APIs, and standards-based exports for government and institutional open data portals.
name: DKAN
RUDI
description: Open-source, deployable territorial data-sharing platform used by Rennes Metropole. A portal indexes metadata from distributed producer nodes; datasets can be open or access-controlled. The rudi-out-of-the-box project provides an independent Docker Compose installation.

name: ODWeb
description: ODWeb is a Chinese municipal and provincial public-data open catalog product that serves the catalog under an /odweb/ path (scripts, skins, and dataset listing). Independent hosts include Changzhi, Jiangmen, and Henan. Distinct from Inspur oPortal (`oportal`) and Zhejiang JDOP (`jdop`).

Piveau is an open-source metadata catalogue platform for public-sector open data portals. It is built around DCAT and DCAT-AP, with a microservice architecture covering harvesting, RDF storage, search, quality metrics, and a customizable catalog UI. It powers portals such as data.europa.eu.
name: Piveau
Andino
description: Andino is a Docker-packaged CKAN distribution developed by the Argentine Republic for the national open data policy. It bundles CKAN with the gobar theme, a time-series explorer (series_explorer), extra harvesters (gobar_ckan_harvester, xlsx_harvester), and the national metadata profile. It powers datos.gob.ar and provincial, municipal, and agency portals across Argentina. Detect via the gobar_theme extension in /api/3/action/status_show.

owner.name: Government of Argentina (Dirección Nacional de Datos Públicos)

name: Craft CMS
description: Craft CMS is Pixel & Tonic's content management system. Some US research-data sites (CUAHSI, Chesapeake Bay Program data hub, Neotoma) publish their data catalog pages through Craft. Signals are the X-Powered-By Craft CMS response header and /cpresources/ asset paths. Data applications inside the CMS (search, download services) are site-custom.
DataPress is a managed open data portal platform used by public sector organizations, combining CKAN-based data catalog functionality with portal publishing and content management features.
name: DataPress
K5 MapServer
description: K5 MapServer (K5MapServer) is MK Consult's municipal web geoportal for Kompas 5. Tenants live at {muni}.k5mapserver.cz with title GEOPORTÁL and shared /core/Page.js. Distinct from UMN MapServer (mapserver) and from T-MAPY GISPLAN (gisplan).

name: Geocentriq
description: Geocentriq is a Quebec municipal GIS SaaS for graphic matrices, assessment rolls, cadastre, and orthophotos. Public tenants live at app.geocentriq.com/mrc/{mrc} with geocentriq.min.js assets and a municipality picker. Distinct from GeoCentralis (geocentralis), SIGimWeb (sigimweb), GOnet (goazimut.com), and SIGALE. One record per public MRC tenant, not per municipality in the picker. Do not register the marketing homepage or /login.

name: InfoGIS
description: InfoGIS is Infokartta Oy's Finnish municipal map SaaS. Public tenants live at www.infogis.fi/{municipality}/ with title InfoGIS, scripts under /codebase-infogis/, OpenLayers, and meta author Infokartta Oy. Distinct from Sitowise Louhi (louhi) and Trimble Locus IMS (trimblelocus). One record per municipality path tenant.

name: Data Library
description: Data Library is a geospatial and climate-focused data portal platform used to publish map-based datasets and interactive maproom views. It supports browsing and discovery of gridded and tabular data, provides downloadable data outputs in common geospatial formats, and is commonly used by meteorological and climate information services.

owner.name: International Research Institute for Climate and Society (IRI), Columbia University

name: AvanMap
description: AvanMap is the browser map client for Integrisoft Solutions' Avansis.Hartă GIS municipal platform. Public deployments use an /AvanMap path, title themselves AvanMap with a version number, and load AvanMap.js plus initAvanMap.js. The product publishes cadastral, planning, asset, utility, and other municipal layers for interactive browsing and measurement.

name: WebEWID
description: WebEWID is GEOMATYKA-KRAKÓW's web interface for the EWID 2007 land and property information system. Its public Portal Mapowy module publishes cadastral and municipal spatial layers through a WebEWID-branded browser map; many deployments also expose standardized cadastral WFS services.

name: PIE-Engine
description: PIE-Engine (Pixel Information Expert Engine) is Piesat's (航天宏图) remote-sensing and geoinformation cloud service platform. The flagship portal at engine.piesat.cn offers a satellite imagery and geospatial dataset catalog, online processing, and thematic applications; thematic nodes (air.piesat.cn and others) reuse the same stack.

name: giscity
description: giscity is ibb DV-Systems' browser municipal GIS. Hosted public tenants live at www.gisserver.de/{city}/ and load portal.js with GIScity Service Hosting credits. Distinct from US gis.cityof* ArcGIS catalogs and from ArcGIS Hub (arcgishub).

name: INVENT WebGIS
description: INVENT WebGIS is the browser-based WebGIS product line of INVENT ltd (Tirana, Albania), built for Albanian public authorities with editing, SDI, and INSPIRE/ASIG interoperability support.
