Public viewers load invent.css and an OpenLayers/dojo client under /aps/?name={tenant} or /apps/?name={tenant}; known deployments are the ARRSH road-authority WebGIS, the ATP property-agency WebGIS, and tenant viewers on INVENT's own hosting (maps.gc-al.com, apps.invent.al — vendor gallery at apps.invent.al). Distinct from the OpenLayers/GeoExt heritage viewers run by IKTK (arkeologjia/monumente.iktk.gov.al), which are a different build.

name: Masterportal
description: Masterportal is an open-source web geoportal developed by Hamburg's Landesbetrieb Geoinformation und Vermessung and used by German federal, state, and municipal agencies. It provides OGC-based map viewers (WMS, WFS, CSW, WPS) for spatial data infrastructures.

name: Weave
description: Weave is Cohga's HTML5 municipal web GIS used by Australian local government. Public council maps use HTML title Weave Map and a webpack app.*.js client. Distinct from IntraMaps Public (intramaps), Exponare (exponare), Pozi (pozi), and Spectrum Spatial Analyst (spectrumspatial). Do not set weave from GeneWeaver or other hosts that merely contain the word weave.

name: GeDA-Public
description: GeDA-Public is Nakano AI System's public WebGIS (住民公開GIS), hosted on geogeo.jp tenant hostnames such as {city}.geogeo.jp and {city}.e-map.geogeo.jp. It publishes municipal map galleries transferred from the internal GeDA integrated GIS. Distinct from GeDA itself, which is staff-only.

OpenWIS is an open-source metadata catalog and data discovery platform designed for meteorological and geospatial information exchange. It provides cataloging, search, and standards-based interoperability features used in weather and climate data infrastructures.
name: OpenWIS
CommunityView
description: CommunityView is Digital Map Products (LightBox) municipal web GIS. Public city tenants live at maps.digitalmapcentral.com/production/VECommunityView/cities/{city}/ with HTML title CommunityView and Powered By Digital Map Products. Distinct from ArcGIS Instant Apps (instantapps) and Bing Maps controls used only as a basemap. Do not register the vendor marketing homepage.

name: VB GIS
description: VB GIS is a Vietnamese municipal and provincial WebGIS platform hosted on tenant subdomains of the vendor domain vbgis.vn, such as gismytho.vbgis.vn (My Tho urban management GIS) and tiengianglis.vbgis.vn (Tien Giang land information system). Public clients provide construction-planning lookup, land-record search, and thematic infrastructure map layers. The operating company's full legal name is not published on the unreachable vendor site; the platform is identified by the tenant-hosting pattern, so confirm the subdomain belongs to vbgis.vn before assigning.

name: GET SDI Portal
description: GET SDI Portal is an open-source spatial data infrastructure client from Geospatial Enabling Technologies. It publishes a tabbed geoportal (map, metadata, files, and services) over GeoServer and GeoNetwork, exposing OGC WMS, WFS, WCS, and CSW to municipal and regional SDIs, especially in Greece.

name: OneGeo Suite
description: Modular open-source geospatial and open-data platform from Neogeo Technologies. Combines data publication, dataset discovery through OneGeo Explorer, maps and an editorial portal. Vendor references identify PIGMA and Data Grand Lyon; DataSud documents its OneGeo Suite catalog integration.

name: Zeljko GIS
description: Zeljko GIS is Zeljko d.o.o.'s Croatian and Bosnian municipal and county Web GIS. Public tenants live on zeljko-gis.com MapGuide Fusion templates (mapguide25/mapguide252/mapguide26) or as cadastral search UIs on zopcina.zeljko-gis.com/{tenant}/, plus county hosts that still load the same Fusion ApplicationDefinition. Distinct from generic MapGuide (mapguide). One record per public tenant, not a second cadastral UI of the same county map.

name: eコミマップ (e-Community Platform)
description: eコミマップ (eコミュニティ・プラットフォーム) is an open-source participatory WebGIS developed by NIED (National Research Institute for Earth Science and Disaster Resilience). Users overlay external layers (WMS, XYZ, TMS, KML) on GSI tiles, build disaster-prevention maps and publish them as open data. It also forms the basis of the 官民協働危機管理クラウド crisis management cloud for municipalities.

owner.name: National Research Institute for Earth Science and Disaster Resilience (NIED)

name: Spatial Suite
description: Spatial Suite (public client SpatialMap) is Sweco's web GIS used by Danish municipalities and utilities. Public webkort viewers load /js/standard/browserdetect.js with a SpatialMap version query. Distinct from NIRAS KortInfo.

name: GeoShop
description: GeoShop is infoGrips' Java geodata shop for publishing, ordering, and downloading official geodata. Data are stored as INTERLIS and delivered in GIS and CAD formats. Swiss cantons, cities, and the federal cadastral portal run public clients. Distinct from GeoMapFish, MAP+, and geoportal.ch map viewers.

name: GeoMapFish
description: GeoMapFish is an open-source WebGIS geoportal platform. The c2cgeoportal Python backend and ngeo client publish OGC services (WMS, WFS, WMTS), theme-based map viewers, and access control. It is widely used by Swiss cantons and other European public-sector geoportals.

name: GIS WebServer SE
description: GIS WebServer SE is a web GIS platform for building geoportals and publishing spatial data services. It is designed for map visualization, layer management, and integration of geospatial resources through web interfaces and standards-based services.

name: SilverBrowser
description: SilverBrowser is Geoservice S.r.l. municipal Web GIS for Italian local governments. Public tenants expose an open-data module at /opendata/ui/www/ or a planning viewer such as SilverPrg at /prg/ui/www/, often on {tenant}.cloud.silverbrowser.it. Distinct from GisMaster (gismaster), GFMaplet (gfmaplet), LDP SIT (ldpgis), PAGIS (genegis), and GeoPortale.cloud (geoportalecloud). One record per public comune viewer, not the staff login.

name: rmDATA GeoWeb
description: rmDATA GeoWeb (also titled rmDATA Online) is a commercial web GIS for municipal and infrastructure maps. Public viewers embed /Application/Compact on the organisation host or a {tenant}.rmdatacloud.com portal. Distinct from rmDATA GeoDesktop and from VertiGIS WebOffice (weboffice).

name: GisMaster
description: GisMaster is Technical Design S.r.l. municipal Web GIS used by Italian comuni. Public GeoPortale tenants live on geoportale.sportellounicodigitale.it/GisMaster with an IdCliente (ISTAT comune code or TD* client id). VisualDesc.aspx / VisualDescNR.aspx is the catalog landing; Default.aspx is the same tenant map, not a second catalog. Distinct from GISApp (gisapp), Masterportal (masterportal), and MapGIS IGServer (mapgisigserver). Skip cemetery VisualCim-only totems and empty boilerplate tenants with no cadastre/PRGC layers.

name: SmartMap
description: SmartMap is a hosted Kazakh district investment geoportal. Public tenants live at {district}.smartmap.kz and share a Leaflet plus Google Maps viewer (stylse.css). Used by West Kazakhstan akimats for land plots, mineral occurrences, and infrastructure map objects. Distinct from Geonomics (geonomics) regional portals and from unrelated SMARTMap finance products.

name: uMap
description: uMap is an open-source collaborative map creator built on OpenStreetMap (Django + Leaflet). Each public instance acts as a map catalog where users publish maps with their own datalayers (GeoJSON); public maps are browsable and searchable on the instance home page and via /{lang}/search/. Widely self-hosted by OSM chapters, French public bodies, and civil-society groups.

name: WebGIS Cloud
description: WebGIS Cloud is the map portal and JavaScript API from Energie Steiermark. Public geoportals are self-hosted or served from webgiscloud.com and load webgis-portal-cloud.js, api.min.js (id webgis-api-script), and webgis-map.min.js. Portal homes use /{instance}/portal/{name}/ or /{instance}/{portal}/. Distinct from GAUSS WebGIS (gausswebgis), DRZ WebGIS (drzwebgis), WebGIS Publisher (webgispublisher), KC WebGIS (kcwebgis), and VertiGIS WebOffice (weboffice).

name: Geocortex Essentials
description: Geocortex Essentials (now VertiGIS Studio) is a commercial web GIS that extends Esri ArcGIS with configurable sites and the Geocortex Viewer for HTML5. Public geoportals typically expose a Geocortex Essentials REST Sites Directory (often /Geocortex/Essentials/REST/sites, ?f=pjson) and/or an Html5Viewer titled Geocortex Viewer for HTML5. Hosted tenants appear under *.geocortex.com. Distinct from VertiGIS WebOffice (weboffice) and VertiGIS Studio Web (vertigisstudioweb).

name: Orhitec ERP/GIS
description: Orhitec ERP/GIS is Orhitec GIS's municipal information server for Israeli local authorities. Public viewers are hosted on erpgis.co.il, either as {authority}.erpgis.co.il or as orhitec.erpgis.co.il/{authority}gispub, with a Hebrew interface for parcels, planning, taxation, and infrastructure. One record per public tenant. Skip the vendor site orhitec.com.

name: vMap2
description: vMap2 is an open-source web GIS from Veremes (successor to Veremap and vMap) for publishing, consulting, and editing geospatial maps in the browser. It is built on PostgreSQL/PostGIS and MapServer, exposes WMS/WFS, and is widely used by French collectivités with optional public map widgets.

name: geoCore
description: geoCore is the Canadian Geospatial Platform's open-source, cloud-native (AWS) geospatial catalog. It stores HNAP / ISO 19115 and provincial metadata in a flexible extended-GeoJSON "metadata lake" and exposes a REST API (bbox search GET /geo, record lookup GET /id, /featured, /foundational, plus API-key contribution endpoints). It harvests GeoNetwork over CSW and STAC catalogs, and powers the app.geo.ca discovery app together with the GeoView map viewer. The app.geo.ca frontend (Canadian-Geospatial-Platform/app.geo.ca-v2, SvelteKit + SST) can be white-labeled so contributors can run their own portal on the shared catalog; as of September 2026 the only production deployment is GEO.ca itself.

owner.name: Natural Resources Canada — Canadian Geospatial Platform

description: GISQuick is an open-source platform for publishing QGIS projects as responsive web map applications. The stack combines a QGIS plugin, a Go/Django server application, QGIS Server, and Vue.js web/mobile clients, communicating over OGC WMS, WMTS, and WFS services. Each published project exposes a public JSON project description and OGC web services.
name: GISQuick

description: GeoPortal.rlp is an open-source SDI suite for managing and publishing geospatial services and metadata, including OWS endpoints (WMS, WFS, CSW), ISO 19139 metadata workflows, map viewers, and organizational access controls. It is developed by the mrmap-community for deployments such as Geoportal Rheinland-Pfalz.
name: GeoPortal.rlp
VertiGIS WebOffice
description: VertiGIS WebOffice (formerly SynerGIS WebOffice) is a commercial web GIS that extends Esri ArcGIS Enterprise with configurable map clients. Public geoportals typically expose a /synserver (or /WebOffice/synserver) application titled VertiGIS WebOffice, often with weboffice_packed.css and core, flex, or mobile clients. Multi-tenant hosting appears under wo-hosting.vertigis.com and map.geoportal.at. Distinct from Geocortex Essentials (geocortex) and VertiGIS Studio Web (vertigisstudioweb).

name: HSLayers NG
description: HSLayers NG is an open-source web mapping framework (Angular + OpenLayers + CesiumJS) used to build map composition catalogs and geoportals. Deployments typically pair the HSLayers NG client with a Layman backend (maps/layers REST API) and Micka metadata catalogue; public map compositions are browsable in the built-in composition catalogue.

owner.name: HSLayers project (CCSS / Help Service - Remote Sensing)

name: PAGIS
description: PAGIS is GeneGIS GI's hosted municipal SIT / WebGIS used by Italian comuni. Tenants live at {comune}.servizigis.it (Index.aspx) and on city-owned hosts such as sit.comune.benevento.it. Distinct from Pulaski Area GIS (www.pagis.org, arcgisserver) and from Emilia-Romagna ArcGIS hosts named servizigis.*. Skip the vendor marketing hubs services.servizigis.it and pagis.it. One record per municipality, not IndexPC.aspx as a second copy of the same SIT when Index.aspx is the public catalog.

name: GP Atlas
description: GP Atlas (геоинформационная платформа «Атлас») is a web GIS from the Territorial Information Fund of the Komi Republic for publishing interactive maps, searching and analyzing spatial data, and managing user access. Public catalogs include the Komi geoportal (gis.rkomi.ru), the Kirov Oblast geoportal (gis.geokirov.ru), and the Arkhangelsk forest-dispatcher Atlas (fires.dvinaland.ru).

owner.name: Territorial Information Fund of the Komi Republic

name: Mapbender
description: Mapbender is an open-source geospatial web framework and geoportal solution for building map applications on top of OGC services and spatial data infrastructures. It provides configurable map viewers, search and editing tools, user and role management, and integrations for publishing and consuming geospatial resources in government and enterprise environments.

name: Tobel
description: Tobel municipal GIS is a Bulgarian Web GIS used by cities and districts for cadastral, urban-planning, and local map layers. Public tenants live at {city}.tobel.bg (and related hosts such as shumenweb.tobel.bg).

name: Geoblox
description: Geoblox is GIM's framework for custom web and mobile mapping applications. Public apps ship the Geoblox name in the page bundle and use OpenLayers or Esri layers plus OGC services. Distinct from the Walloon Geoviewer API and from GeoSolutions MapStore. One record per public dataset or map application, not the GIM marketing site. Skip login-only deployments.

name: Geolonia スマートマップ
description: Geolonia 公開型GIS「スマートマップ」 is a Digital Agency model-spec public WebGIS for Japanese local governments. Multi-tenant brands include とっとりジオマップ on {org}.tottori-geomap.jp and 香川県 公開型GIS -BRIDGES-. Viewers are Next.js apps with Geolonia vector basemaps. Distinct from Kazakhstan SmartMap (smartmap).

name: LocalGIS
description: LocalGIS is the municipal GIS distributed to Spanish town councils under the LOCALGIS plan. Public viewers identify the product in the page (LOCALGIS Hoja de Producto, or a localgis path). GeoCuenca is a live example. Distinct from gvSIG Online, enMapa, and a generic municipal map page that only mentions GIS.

name: Argenmap
description: Argenmap is the Argentine National Geographic Institute's open-source Leaflet map viewer. Self-hosted deployments use the Argenmap src/js application tree and a JSON configuration to publish grouped layers, including WMS and WMTS sources. Distinct from generic Leaflet applications that do not carry the Argenmap source layout or IGN template identifiers.

owner.name: Instituto Geográfico Nacional de la República Argentina

name: Tianditu
description: Tianditu (Map World) is China's National Geographic Information Public Service Platform. National, provincial, and municipal nodes share a common architecture, APIs, and branding for authoritative online maps, geocoding, and geospatial data services operated under NGCC technical standards.

name: MangoMap
description: MangoMap is a hosted web-mapping SaaS for publishing interactive map galleries and geospatial datasets. Organization portals are served from mangomap.com tenant URLs.

name: touvia.MAPS
description: touvia.MAPS is vianovis GmbH's hosted municipal web GIS (touvia.geoCMS plus Cesium viewer). Public tenants live at vianovis.net/{tenant}/ or a city host that loads touvia.de/scripts/loader.js and loadTouviaMaps(). Distinct from Hamburg Masterportal (masterportal) even when vianovis also hosts touvia.MASTERPORTAL.

name: Go GIS
description: Go GIS is SunGIS's (SIA SunGIS, Latvia) browser and QGIS geospatial data-management product for municipalities and municipal utilities. Public tenants are hosted on {org}.gis.sungis.lv and title the Angular SPA Gogis V2 or GogisFrontendV3, loading OpenLayers plus /assets/images/gogis_logo_white-min.png. Distinct from Indixio GoMap (gomap) on geomapguide.ca, from Latvian terGIS (tergis) and pGIS (pgis), and from Stellenbosch University's sungis08 GeoServer.

name: SonicWeb
description: SonicWeb (SonicWeb-Cloud) is Kokusai Kogyo's hosted public WebGIS for Japanese prefectures and municipalities. Public tenants live under www.sonicweb-asp.jp/{slug}/ and load sonicweb.js. Distinct from the internal SonicWeb-i / SonicWeb-EXT integrated GIS.

name: IndorRoad Geoportal
description: IndorRoad Geoportal (IndorGeo) is ИндорСофт's browser geoportal for GIS IndorRoad road-asset databases. Public tenants expose a PHP landing page titled IndorGeo and a React map/table app at /geo3/ (older installs use /dashboard/ with /assets/indorgeo/ig1.js), covering road passports, diagnostics, accidents, and related objects without installing the desktop GIS.

name: 1Map
description: 1Map is the municipal geoportal module of the 1Doc public administration suite (1Doc Tecnologia S.A., Florianopolis, SC, Brazil). It shows real-time municipal service requests and thematic territorial layers. Tenants are municipality subdomains of 1map.com.br (for example americana.1map.com.br, taubate.1map.com.br) running a Next.js viewer titled "1Map" that requires sign-in (/auth/unauthenticated callback). Not to be confused with the South African 1map platform (1map.co.za), a separate product.

name: GeoMoose
description: GeoMoose is an open-source WebGIS JavaScript framework, an OSGeo community project originally created for Minnesota state and county governments. Version 2 pairs a PHP/MapScript frontend with MapServer mapfiles; version 3 is a React/Redux client with small Node or PHP services (identify, search, select, geocode). Widely deployed by US counties and by agencies in Mongolia, Latin America, and Europe as public parcel and thematic map viewers.

name: GeoCentralis
description: GeoCentralis is a Quebec municipal GIS SaaS (Évimbec) for graphic matrices, assessment rolls, cadastre, and zoning. Public tenants live at portail.geocentralis.com/public/sig-web/{mrc}/{code}/ with a municipality picker. Distinct from Geocentriq (app.geocentriq.com), SIGimWeb (sigimweb), GOnet (goazimut.com), and SIGALE. One record per public MRC or city slug, not per geo-code path. Do not register the marketing homepage, staff /core/login/, or a second zonage URL for the same tenant.

name: Geonodo
description: Geonodo is the open geospatial platform of Chile's Secretaría Ejecutiva SNIT - IDE Chile. Public institutions run it as an IDE node with an ISO 19115 metadata catalog, map viewers, and a page builder. The public catalog is a Laravel Livewire app ("Descubre N datos territoriales", assets under /images/metadatagis/) with pycsw CSW at /csw. Distinct from GeoNode, including GeoNode hosts whose names contain geonodo.

name: Sampaş WebGIS
description: Sampaş WebGIS is the municipal city-guide map in Sampaş Bilişim's AKOS (Akıllı Kent Otomasyon Sistemi) suite. Public instances are typically published at /KentrehberiApp/Index and title the page with SAMPAŞ WEBGIS.

name: deegree
description: deegree is an open-source Java framework for spatial data infrastructures and OGC web services. It provides reference implementations of WMS, WFS, WMTS, CSW and WPS, plus deegree ogcapi for OGC API Features, and is widely used for INSPIRE-compliant geospatial service stacks.

name: MS-GIS
description: MS-GIS is a Lower Austria municipal GeoInformation viewer hosted at {city}.msgis.net with HTML title {City} GeoInformation. Distinct from Masterportal (masterportal), touvia.MAPS (touviamaps), and VC Map (vcmap). Do not register the marketing homepage.

name: Spectrum Spatial Analyst
description: Spectrum Spatial Analyst is Precisely's (formerly Pitney Bowes / MapInfo) browser GIS used by councils and regional bodies as a public map catalog. It supersedes Exponare. Public sites use path /connect/analyst/ or /connect/analyst/mobile/, HTML title Spectrum Spatial (sometimes a local brand), Precisely favicon assets, and mapcfg= project parameters. Distinct from Exponare (/exponare/), IntraMaps, ArcGIS Hub/REST, and Experience Builder on the same owner.

name: GajaMatrix GeoPortal
description: GajaMatrix GeoPortal / GDI-Knoten is the public web portal and GDI node module of the GajaMatrix municipal GIS by Gingko.Systeme, aimed at small and medium-sized German municipalities. Public GeoPortal frontends show a "GajaMatrix GeoPortal" page title or send an x-powered-by "GajaMatrix GIS" header (WildFly backend); documented tenants include Merseburg, Gera, Wasser Nord, Rudolstadt, Altenburg, and Elsterwerda. The vendor-hosted backends on {tenant}.gajamatrix.de/geoserver and gdi.gajamatrix.de/geonetwork are tagged with those software ids, not this one. Distinct from disy Cadenza (cadenza).

name: CTMGEO SigWEB
description: CTMGEO SigWEB is a Brazilian municipal cadastral WebGIS hosted at {city}.ctmgeo.com.br/mapa/. Public tenants share title SIGWeb and a cadastral lot map. Distinct from unrelated municipal sites that reuse the generic SIGWeb label on other vendors or .gov.br hosts.

name: KaartViewer
description: KaartViewer is GeoSquare / GeoNovation's Dutch municipal GIS suite. Public tenants live at {org}.kaartviewer.nl or a city hostname (kaart.utrecht.nl, kaartviewer.maastricht.nl) with a KaartViewer menu API at /admin/rest/kaartviewerapi/menu. Distinct from GeoServer backends on the same estate (geoserver). One record per public tenant, not per map in the menu, and not the vendor demo.

name: Elvis
description: Elvis (Elevation Information System) is Geoscience Australia's national elevation and depth data service, delivered under the Foundation Spatial Data Framework (FSDF). Users draw areas of interest to order and download LiDAR point clouds, digital elevation models, and bathymetry in bulk. Single hosted instance at elevation.fsdf.org.au; do not confuse with unrelated sites that merely mention Elvis.

name: SHK Kent Bilgi Sistemi
description: SHK Kent Bilgi Sistemi is SHK Bilişim Teknolojileri's municipal geographic-information product for publishing city guides, parcel and zoning searches, plan notes, and thematic points of interest. Confirmed deployments include Gölbaşı, Pursaklar, and Üsküdar; clients use ArcGIS JavaScript and municipality-hosted ArcGIS REST services, with older installations displaying the SHK logo directly.

name: ISY Map
description: ISY Map is Norconsult Digital's municipal web GIS (also ISY Map Server and GeoInnsyn). Public viewers use /geoinnsyn/ or /webkart/, titles ISYMap or ISY Map Server, and often hosts on *.isy.no. Distinct from Avinet Adaptive (avinet) county atlases and from ArcGIS Hub on nordlandsatlas.nfk.no.

name: Astun iShare
description: Astun iShare is a UK local-government enterprise GIS and public mapping portal (iShare Maps, My Maps, My House / Find my nearest), often hosted as iShare in the Cloud. Public viewers typically show “Powered by iShare” and ASP.NET paths such as /mymaps.aspx. Distinct from the INDEPTH iShare microdata catalog and from Cadcorp SIS WebMap (cadcorp).

name: Cadcorp SIS WebMap
description: Cadcorp SIS WebMap (backed by GeognoSIS) is a commercial web GIS used by UK and other local authorities as the public map portal. Public sites are typically branded SIS WebMap or Web Map Layers. Distinct from disy Cadenza (cadenza) and from Astun iShare (ishare). Vendor is now NEC Software Solutions UK.

name: LDP SIT
description: LDP SIT is LDP Progetti GIS's hosted municipal territorial information system used by Italian comuni and unions. Public tenants live at cloud.ldpgis.it/{comune}/ (and sct-*.ldpgis.it / maps1.ldpgis.it slugs) and on city-owned hosts such as maps.comune.arezzo.it. Interactive maps use LdP Viewer (OpenLayers). Distinct from Drupal as the public catalog (Drupal is only the CMS shell), from GeneGIS PAGIS (genegis), and from Maggioli GFMaplet (gfmaplet). Skip the vendor marketing hub cloud.ldpgis.it/ with no comune slug and empty placeholder tenants that only repeat the LDP product homepage.

name: Mundi
description: Mundi is GEIS Pty Limited's enterprise web GIS that extends GE Network Viewer for GE Smallworld geospatial systems. Australian and New Zealand utilities and local governments deploy it as a public mapping portal (sometimes branded WebSpatial). Distinct from Danish WSP NetGIS Runtime (netgisruntime), IntraMaps Public (intramaps), Weave (weave), and ArcGIS Hub on the same owner.

name: ErdaGIS
description: ErdaGIS web is Erda Kft.'s municipal web GIS, built on MapServer with an OpenLayers client. Public tenants use {settlement}.erda.hu (Aszód, Debrecen, Balatongyörök) or gis.erda.hu/erda/html/projects/{id}/main.php (Jászfényszaru, Alsómocsolád). Distinct from EnviMAP (envimap), Autodesk MapGuide (mapguide), and a bare MapServer (mapserver).

name: PRODIGE
description: Open-source infrastructure for multi-partner geographic data sharing, cataloging, storage, downloads and web mapping. Integrates a metadata catalog and spatial services. DatARA documents its deployment of version 5 and exposes a PRODIGE resource API. Distinct from its separately registered GeoNetwork catalog component.

name: DashGIS
description: DashGIS is California CAD Solutions’ browser and mobile GIS portal for California counties, cities, and special districts. Public tenants live as path apps on mydashgis.com (for example /SierraCountyPublic/, /TCCWDPublic/) and share the same Angular shell with a California CAD Solutions copyright header. Internal staff paths without the Public suffix are not public catalogs. One record per public tenant.

name: Sentinel Hub
description: Sentinel Hub (Sinergise / Planet) is a commercial Earth-observation platform with a STAC Catalog API, OGC WMS/WMTS/WCS, Process API, and EO Browser / Copernicus Browser clients. Official catalog hosts include services.sentinel-hub.com and collections.sentinel-hub.com. Prefer sentinelhub over stacserver for Sentinel Hub Catalog. Distinct from openEO backends (openeo), including the Sentinel Hub openEO API on Copernicus Data Space.

name: eKMap Cloud
description: eKMap Cloud is eKGIS's Vietnamese provincial planning GIS. Public viewers share Mapbox GL JS 1.13, `assets/ekmapboxgl/ekmap-mapboxgl.js`, `assets/ekmapboxgl/common.js`, and mapbox-gl-compare, often with title `eKMap Cloud`. Distinct from Hanoi `quyhoach.hanoi.gov.vn` (Next.js, not eKMap), Vinh Phuc OpenLayers 6 planning maps, and HCMC VLAB Leaflet planning. Do not set ekmap from a site that only loads Mapbox GL without the ekmapboxgl assets.

name: IGVT
description: IGVT (internal "IGeo Viewer Template", npm gis-viewer-template) is the in-house GIS viewer framework of the State Geodetic Administration of Croatia (DGU, Državna geodetska uprava). DGU operates branded deployments for other Croatian state bodies; installations share igvt_* internals (igvt_local_features, __igvt_group_, IGVT.ENV) and an igeo-loading bootstrap element. Live deployments include GeoHrvatska (geohrvatska.hr), the HAC Geoportal (geoportal.hac.hr), Bioportal GIS (bioportal.hr/gis) and the NIPP geoportal viewer (geoportal.nipp.hr). Distinct from DGU's newer EnGeon viewer (geoportal.dgu.hr, 2025 relaunch, engeon-app element).

name: わが街ガイド
description: わが街ガイド (Wagmap) is PASCO's hosted public WebGIS for Japanese prefectures and municipalities. Tenants publish map galleries and, on many sites, an open-data catalog. Installations run on www2.wagmap.jp or a custom domain and load GeoAccessJS portal assets.

name: MapProxy
description: MapProxy is an open source proxy and cache for map services that accelerates and unifies access to geospatial data sources. It aggregates, tiles, and republishes map content from OGC and web map services through configurable WMS, WMTS, and TMS endpoints for geoportal and GIS applications.

name: inkasPortal
description: inkasPortal is GeoNet Online's public geoinformation viewer and the successor to inkasWeb. Deployments identify the vendor in the title and load a distinctive Angular/OpenLayers client with static/js/inkas-portal.js, inkas-themenctrl.js, and optional inkas@work and inkasDokument modules.

name: Geodeticca WEB GIS
description: Geodeticca WEB GIS is GEODETICCA VISION's municipal map client. Public tenants live at gis.{city}.sk, title the page Geodeticca WEB GIS, and load /js/config.js plus /js/build/libs.js. Distinct from CORA GEO CG WebGIS (cgwebgis) and T-MAPY GISPLAN (gisplan).

name: open-hinata (ひなたGIS)
description: open-hinata is the open-source edition (OpenLayers 5 + Vue) of ひなたGIS, the free public WebGIS originally built for Miyazaki Prefecture. Layers are added via js/layers.js. The open-hinata3 / OH3 fork (oh3lab.jp/oh3/) targets land surveyors with 登記所地図 (地図XML), 地番図 and SIMA exchange.

name: CGI WebGIS (Facta WebGIS)
description: CGI WebGIS, deployed in earlier installations as Facta WebGIS, publishes Finnish municipal register and geospatial data in a browser map. Facta WebGIS 4 deployments have that exact HTML title and load facta.css plus bundle.js from a /karttapalvelu.{tenant}/ application path.

name: ncWMS
description: ncWMS is an open-source web map service for serving NetCDF and other multidimensional environmental data as dynamic map layers. It provides OGC WMS support for scientific and meteorological datasets, enabling rendering, styling, and extraction workflows for geospatial portals and clients.

owner.name: Reading e-Science Centre, University of Reading

name: EverGIS
description: EverGIS (ЭверГИС) is a web GIS platform from Everpoint for creating, editing, and publishing maps, layers, and spatial tables. It is available as free hosted EverGIS Online and as an on-premises server, with a REST API and OGC publication (WMS, WFS, WMTS).

name: ArcGIS Dashboards
description: ArcGIS Dashboards is Esri's configurable location-analytics dashboard application for ArcGIS Online and ArcGIS Enterprise. Public dashboards use /apps/dashboards/{item-id} and present maps, indicators, charts, gauges, and lists backed by ArcGIS items and services. Distinct from ArcGIS Hub (arcgishub), ArcGIS Experience Builder (experiencebuilder), ArcGIS Web AppBuilder (webappbuilder), and ArcGIS Instant Apps (instantapps).

NextGIS Web is an open-source geospatial platform for publishing, managing, and editing spatial data through a web interface. It supports vector and raster layers, web maps, user access control, and integration via REST and OGC-compatible services.
name: NextGIS Web
GoMap
description: Indixio GoMap (formerly Geomap GIS Amérique, hosting brand iGeoMapGuide / geomapguide.ca) is a proprietary web GIS platform built on MapGuide Open Source and FDO for publishing, viewing, querying, and editing geospatial data. SaaS tenants live on {client}.geomapguide.ca; on-premise tenants use paths such as /gomap/ or /map/ on the owner domain. Viewer title pattern "GoMap - {tenant}", scripts under /gomap_web/, MapGuide mapagent backend. Distinct from SIGimWeb (sigimweb), the Indixio Quebec municipal assessment viewer on the same engine, and from generic MapGuide (mapguide) sites. One record per public tenant.

pycsw is an open source OGC API - Records and CSW server implementation for publishing and searching geospatial metadata. It supports standards-based discovery, harvesting, and catalog interoperability for spatial data infrastructures and geoportals.
name: pycsw
MapStore
description: MapStore (MapStore2) is an open-source web GIS framework from GeoSolutions for building geoportals and map viewers. It provides catalog search, map composition, and integration with GeoServer and other OGC services (WMS, WFS, WMTS, CSW). GAUSS WebCity / WebPresenter tenants use software.id gausswebcity, not mapstore.

name: IDEBA Visualizador
description: IDEBA Visualizador is the hosted municipal map-viewer platform of the Buenos Aires Province spatial data infrastructure (IDEBA, Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales de la Provincia de Buenos Aires). Municipal tenants live at visualizador.ideba.gba.gob.ar/{municipio} as a Leaflet application (src/leaflet/plugins/*, map-toolbar.css) backed by per-tenant GeoServer workspaces at geoserver-nodo2.ideba.gba.gob.ar/geoserver/{municipio}/wfs|wms. One record per public municipal tenant; the province-level GeoNetwork catalog and GeoServer nodes are separate records.

name: NAZCA
description: NAZCA is Soltesoft's hosted cadastral-management software. Its public municipal viewers use numeric tenant routes under apps.nazcacatastro.com/public, load a shared OpenLayers main.js client plus a municipality-specific config file, and provide parcel search, layer browsing, measurement, Street View, and local SHP, KML, or GeoJSON overlay loading.

ERDAS APOLLO is an enterprise geospatial content management and dissemination platform from Hexagon. It is used to catalog, govern, and publish raster and vector geospatial data and services, with support for metadata-driven discovery and OGC-compliant web service delivery in spatial data infrastructure deployments.
name: ERDAS APOLLO

description: hale»connect is wetransform's data-infrastructure platform for transforming, validating, and publishing INSPIRE, XPlanung, and other OGC datasets. Public clouds and on-prem tenants expose CSW (often pycsw-backed), WMS, WFS, and OGC API services. Register the public catalog UI or CSW root, not the bundled pycsw as a separate product.
name: hale»connect
CG WebGIS
description: CG WebGIS is CORA GEO's municipal geographic web portal (WebGIS v2). Public tenants live at webgis.{city}.sk or a city host that still loads the jQuery 1.10 / tabSlideOut client and titles the page WebGIS v2, CG or WebGIS {city}. Distinct from T-MAPY GISPLAN (gisplan).

name: Geocad System Enterprise Edition
description: Geocad System Enterprise Edition (GSEE) is a proprietary geospatial platform from Geocad plus for regional, municipal and urban-planning information systems. Public portals publish thematic worksets, searchable spatial layers and object semantics through a shared web client and GSEE REST services.

name: SOFTPRO
description: SOFTPRO Містобудівний кадастр is a Ukrainian urban-planning cadastre GIS. Public tenants live at {city}.cadastre.com.ua or city MBK hosts and mention SOFTPRO in the page, with either a Tailwind /assets/index-*.js geoportal or the older /js/locale/ua.js client with explicit SOFTPRO branding. Distinct from the state Urban Planning Cadastre (kadastr.gov.ua) and from StateGeoCadastre map.land.gov.ua.

name: NOL-IS
description: NOL-IS is a commercial municipal WebGIS and geoportal platform used by German local governments to publish maps, geodata, and related services. Deployments commonly load viewer assets from maps.nol-is.de or static.nol-is.de.

name: 3MAP
description: 3MAP is 3 PORT IT's municipal GIS viewer within the 3OIS public administration suite. Public applications use tenant paths on 3-port.si and share /desk/ assets, Translations_mini.js, GISProjectListing_mini.js, and the vendor's 3MAP help tree under /trimap/_common/resource/help/.

name: Isogeo
description: Isogeo is a French SaaS catalog for GIS metadata (OpenCatalog and App). Public portals expose an OpenAPI at /api and a searchable inventory of ISO 19115 datasets, often with CSW. Distinct from IsiGéo (isigeo), the Geomatika geoportal product.

name: Map2Web
description: Map2Web by Schubert & Franzke (St. Pölten, AT) is a municipal digital town plan viewer. Tenants live at {city}.map2web.eu for AT/DE/IT/LI and {region}-city.map2web.eu / {region}-county.map2web.eu for RO, served as a Vue.js app with title Map2Web and static.maptoolkit.net/mtk script tags. Distinct from MS-GIS (msgis). Do not register the vendor marketing homepage.

name: UrbisMap
description: UrbisMap is UrbisMap S.r.l.s. hosted national Web GIS for Italian urban-planning, cadastre, constraint, and regulatory layers. The public geoportal is a single hub at www.urbismap.com (Vue app, /v2, and /territorio/{slug} city pages). Affiliated comuni publish on that hub rather than separate tenant hosts. Distinct from GeoPortale.cloud (geoportalecloud), GisMaster (gismaster), GeneGIS PAGIS (genegis), LDP SIT (ldpgis), and p.mapper (pmapper). Skip the marketing site urbismap.it, CRM, tiles/tiler, status, analytics, 401 beta hosts, dead archivio.* / catasto subdomains, and FOIA Accesso agli Atti.

name: Geodados SaaS
description: Geodados SaaS (Sistema Geodados) is a Brazilian municipal GIS from Geodados Geoprocessamento in São José do Rio Preto, SP. Public tenants live at {city}.geodados.com.br/Publico with OpenLayers, anonymous access (acessoAnonimo = true), thematic maps, and viability queries. Staff login at the tenant root is not a catalog. Distinct from ArcGIS Hub sites named Geodados and from GeoNode geodados.daee.sp.gov.br. Nonexistent city hosts fail DNS. Skip oracle.geodados.com.br (internal) and www.geodados.com.br (marketing).

name: terGIS
description: terGIS is a Latvian territorial-planning and public-engagement GIS (METRUM / TOPO DATI) hosted on {tenant}.tergis.lv. Municipal tenants use an Angular SPA with a public /api/v1/classifiers/layers catalog; some territorial-plan viewers use a QWC2 frontend on the same domain. Distinct from generic QWC2 (qwc2) off tergis.lv and from the sibling pGIS (pgis.lv) product.

name: GeoBlacklight
description: GeoBlacklight is an open-source geospatial discovery platform built on Blacklight and Apache Solr. It offers map-based and keyword search, faceted browsing, customizable metadata (including OpenGeoMetadata and the GeoBlacklight schema), and download and export options for maps and datasets. It is developed as a multi-institutional collaboration; the software is copyright Stanford University and licensed under Apache 2.0.

name: GeoMixer
description: GeoMixer (Kosmosnimki) is a web GIS platform developed by ScanEx. It powers map-centric geoportals with a layer tree, vector and raster data publishing, satellite imagery catalogs, and a JavaScript/REST API (geomixer.js) used both for ScanEx-operated services (kosmosnimki.ru, fires.ru, search.kosmosnimki.ru) and for third-party thematic maps that embed the Kosmosnimki maps API.

Koordinates is a cloud-native geospatial data platform used by governments, utilities, and private organizations to publish, manage, discover, and share spatial datasets. It supports enterprise data governance workflows, metadata management, and open-data publication with built-in APIs and OGC services for integration with GIS and analytics ecosystems.
name: Koordinates
GISNET V5
description: GISNET V5 is Complot's hosted municipal GIS platform for Israeli municipalities, local and regional councils. Public tenants live at v5.gis-net.co.il/v5/{authority}/ and on the older mg{1,2}.gis-net.co.il/{Authority}Gis generation, with page titles "GISNET V5 By Complot - {city}" and a Hebrew interface for planning, parcels, land-use, and engineering layers. Dozens of authorities run public tenants; some cities use dedicated hosts (gisn.tel-aviv.gov.il). One record per public tenant.

name: VKOMAP
description: VKOMAP is Geoinfo's municipal and regional geoportal for Kazakh akimats. Public tenants share Leaflet plus Esri assets under /vkomap/, language paths such as /Kaz, and JSON APIs at /Public/GetKatoList and /Public/GetLayers. Distinct from Geonomics (Vue/Mapbox akimat portals) and from SmartMap district investment sites.

name: disy Cadenza
description: disy Cadenza is a commercial data analytics, reporting, and GIS platform from Disy Informationssysteme. German public-sector geoportals typically expose Cadenza Web or Cadenza Workbooks as a browser catalog of maps, tables, charts, and dashboards. Classic installs use JSF paths such as /cadenza/, /public/, or /pages/map/; Workbooks installs use a navigator of workbooks. Page fingerprints include cadenza in HTML/JS, disy branding, and often a guest login before the public theme tree.

name: SITMUN
description: SITMUN is Diputació de Barcelona's municipal GIS product for Catalan local government. The public viewer at sitmun.diba.cat publishes territorial map catalogs. Distinct from generic Sitmun branding elsewhere and from ArcGIS REST on the same estate. One record per public SITMUN catalog, not per municipality overlay.

name: KortInfo
description: KortInfo is NIRAS' hosted web GIS used by Danish municipalities and utilities. Public citizen maps run on drift.kortinfo.net/Map.aspx with a Site tenant and page such as Borgersite or kortHjemmeside. Distinct from Sweco Spatial Suite (spatialsuite).

name: GeoApps
description: GeoApps is a Dutch hosted map-app SaaS. Public regional viewers use {org}.geoapps.nl or a branded city host. Most {org}.geoapps.nl tenants are staff login; register only unauthenticated public maps. Distinct from generic "geo apps" pages, ArcGIS, and GeoServer. One record per public viewer, not per project map on the same tenant when they share a catalog.

name: JMap
description: JMap is K2 Geospatial's map-based integration platform (JMap Web and JMap NG). Public catalogs use /JMapWeb/ with jmap.min.js, JMap NG /services/ng/ loading jmapserver-ng, or hosted tenants on *.jmaponline.net. Distinct from ArcGIS viewers and from hostnames that merely contain "jmap" (Gyeongju gjmap, Rutgers NJMaps). Do not register JMap Admin login.

name: VC Map
description: VC Map is Virtual City Systems' open-source 2D/3D web GIS (OpenLayers plus Cesium). Public digital-twin and city-model apps use html.vcs-ui, title VC Map, and load ./assets/start.js, including tenants on virtualcitymap.de. Distinct from Hamburg Masterportal (masterportal) and vianovis touvia.MAPS (touviamaps).

name: ALANDIS+
description: ALANDIS+ is Asia Air Survey's hosted public WebGIS (公開型GIS) for Japanese prefectures and municipalities. Public tenants commonly live under webgis.alandis.jp/{tenant}/ and load autologin_jswebgis. Distinct from staff-only ALANDIS NEO / LGWAN integrated GIS.

name: Dielmo Maps
description: Dielmo Maps (Neobora) is a Spanish SaaS for public web geoportals. City hosts such as geo.{city}.es redirect to /gvw/?scenarioid= with the HTML title Neobora, favicon favicon_neobora.svg, and script hosts maps.dielmo.com or *.neobora.ai. One record per public scenario, not per layer.

SuperMap iServer is an enterprise geospatial server platform for publishing, managing, and sharing spatial data and GIS services. It provides RESTful and OGC service interfaces for map visualization, feature access, raster coverage, and integration into web and desktop geospatial applications.
name: SuperMap iServer
Re:Earth
description: Re:Earth is an open-source WebGIS for building 3D digital-twin and map applications on Cesium. Japan's Project PLATEAU VIEW (2.0 and later) is built on Re:Earth and publishes catalog and CityGML APIs.

name: dpWebmap
description: dpWebmap is Digpro's browser-based client for dpSpatial and related network and municipal GIS products. Deployments commonly use a /bios/dpwebmap/ application root, the dpWebmap title, and a compiled app.htmlclient.gwt.DPWebApp.nocache.js client. The viewer can publish layers from WMS, WFS, and other configured geodata services.

name: DRZ WebGIS
description: DRZ WebGIS (Plataforma SIG Web) is a Brazilian municipal cadastral WebGIS from DRZ Territórios Inteligentes. Public tenants live at webgis.drz.com.br/{city}/ with OpenLayers, meta Rodolfo/DRZ Geotecnologia, and lot/zoning search. Nonexistent city paths return nginx 404 (not a wildcard). Distinct from CTMGEO SigWEB (ctmgeo), Geodados SaaS (geodados), and Geopixel Cidades (geopixel). Skip the nginx default root, /drz/ clients map, Tomcat manager, and demo/docs/examples paths.

name: CatasIA
description: CatasIA is Gentemóvil's multipurpose-cadastre product for Colombian cadastral managers. It runs on ArcGIS and the LADM-COL model and is licensed as software as a service. The public dissemination portal is an Angular application whose client bundle contains the string logCatasia. Villavicencio publishes that portal at catasia.villavicencio.gov.co. Do not infer CatasIA from a generic cadastral geoportal, or from a back-office license that has no public dissemination site.

name: Civil Solutions Tax Map Viewer
description: Civil Solutions Tax Map Viewer (TMV) is the hosted municipal tax-map application of Civil Solutions, a division of ARH Associates (Adams, Rehmann & Heggan). Public tenants live at tmv.civilsolutions.biz/viewer/{tenant-id} with titles "{Municipality} Tax Maps" or "{County} Tax Map Viewer", a Mazer-based viewer, block/lot, address, and map-sheet search, and parcel detail panels. Documented tenants include Howell, Wall Township, Hudson County, Teaneck, Washington Township, Jersey City, and Edison in New Jersey. One record per public tenant.

name: Configurable Map Viewer (CMV)
description: CMV (The Configurable Map Viewer) is a community-supported open-source mapping framework built with the Esri JavaScript API (3.x) and the Dojo Toolkit. Deployments load cmv/cmv-app viewer assets (for example viewer/css/main.css), configure the viewer through js/config/viewer.js with a dojoConfig block, and commonly reference cmv.io. It works with ArcGIS Server and ArcGIS Online services and is popular with US local-government GIS sites and national SDI portals.
capabilities: ArcGIS Server and ArcGIS Online integration

name: GeoMedia SmartClient Public Maps
description: GIS Quadrat PublicMaps is a Hexagon GeoMedia SmartClient public viewer. Municipal tenants live at publicmaps.gisquadrat.com/BP/WEPM.aspx with site=GMSC and a per-town project= slug, sharing title GeoMedia SmartClient Public Maps and ig.publicmaps.application.min.js. Distinct from GeoMedia WebMap Geospatial Portal (geomediawebmap) and from GIS Quadrat ERDAS APOLLO on apollo.gisquadrat.com. Do not register the marketing homepage. Skip the retired gis-klagenfurt.at host replaced by Klagenfurt's HxDR digital twin.

name: Amnex Smart City GIS
description: Smart-city GIS portals built by Amnex Infotechnologies (Ahmedabad) for Indian Smart City missions. Shared citymap_js codebase (AppData.js under /js/citymap_js/, citymap_css styles, rmchome.css reused across tenants) with Leaflet/OpenLayers viewers, department layers, and citizen feedback modules. Footer credit "Powered by AMNEX" or Amnex_Logo.svg. Current Amnex products (Locomate, ATS, OSRTC DMS) are transit/HR systems, not catalogs - skip them, bare-IP mirrors, and login-only tenants.

name: iObčina
description: iObčina (Croatian iOpćina) is Kaliopa's cloud municipal GIS. Public viewers use ASP.NET /gisapp/Default.aspx?a={tenant} on gis.iobcina.si and iopcina.hr. Distinct from Romanian GISApp (gisapp) on gisapp.ro and from EQWC.

name: PISO
description: PISO (Prostorski informacijski sistem občin) is Realis's municipal GIS for Slovenia. The public hub at geoprostor.net / PisoPortal covers 150+ municipalities with cadastral, planning, and infrastructure layers and publishes OGC services for QGIS/ArcGIS. Distinct from Kaliopa iObčina (iobcina).

Oskari is an open-source geospatial platform and framework for building national and local geoportals. It provides map publishing, spatial data visualization, and integration capabilities through configurable APIs and OGC-compatible services.
name: Oskari
Septima Search
description: Septima Search is a hosted geodata search component from the Danish company Septima, embedded in public map applications such as the Danmarks Miljøportal clients (septima-search-dmp/v1.js) and served from search.cdn.septima.dk. The companion Septima Widget (widget.cdn.septima.dk/latest/widgetapi.js) is a simple embeddable map, not a catalog. Septima Search apps search across Danish geodata sources (addresses, places, cadastre, WFS/GeoJSON layers) and are typically bespoke per customer.

name: WebGIS Publisher
description: WebGIS Publisher is NieuwlandGeo's municipal map-management system, the predecessor of Onemap. Public catalogs are themakaart choosers, often Choosemap.aspx on a municipal host. Distinct from NieuwlandGeo Onemap ({org}.webgis.nl) and from GeoServer backends on webgispublisher.nl.

name: MAP+
description: MAP+ is TYDAC AG's modular WebGIS. Public city maps load /mapplus-lib/ and OpenLayers, often with tydac branding. Used by Swiss municipalities (Chur, St. Gallen, Biel, geoJura bernois) and sold in Germany as GeoAS Web. Distinct from GeoMapFish (geomapfish) and from mf-geoadmin3 (mfgeoadmin3).

name: openEO
description: openEO is an open API and ecosystem for cloud-native Earth observation processing. Backends expose a JSON landing page with api_version, STAC-compatible /collections, and /processes for process graphs. Used by Copernicus Data Space, VITO, EODC, mundialis Actinia, and other EO platforms.

name: Sputnik Web
description: Sputnik Web is a server platform from Geoscan for publishing and sharing georeferenced 3D models, terrain, raster and vector maps, panoramas, media and attachments. Public installations use numbered /location/{id} pages and a shared /resources/ application bundle; it can be hosted on a customer's own server.

name: TerraVisu
description: TerraVisu is the open-source territorial data visualization platform from Makina Corpus and Autonomens (Terralego). Public catalogs are interactive map observatories that list thematic scenes and layer trees from a Django API (`/api/geolayer/scene/`, `/api/geolayer/view/{slug}/`). Distinct from older Terralego Angular apps on terralego.com that lack those endpoints.

name: gvSIG Online
description: gvSIG Online is an open-source web platform for building spatial data infrastructures and municipal geoportals. It provides an administration UI for publishing layers, defining symbology, creating map viewers, and managing permissions, and integrates GeoServer (required) and optionally GeoNetwork for OGC services and metadata cataloguing. It is developed by the gvSIG Association and Scolab and is licensed under the Affero GPL.

name: MxSIG
description: MxSIG is INEGI's open-source web GIS (Mapa Digital de México V6). Public viewers load /mdm6/ or /mxsig2/ with jquery 1.9, amplify.js, lz-string, and title Mapa Digital de México. Distinct from OVIE (ovie), which is a separate OpenLayers/Materialize economic template. Do not set mxsig from a generic OpenLayers copy or from Gaia DENUE wrapper pages that are not the MDM6 viewer.

name: IntraMaps Public
description: IntraMaps Public is TechnologyOne Spatial's municipal web GIS used by Australian and New Zealand councils. Public maps use title IntraMaps, ApplicationEngine frontend assets (poweredByLogo.png), project=Public query parameters, on-prem paths such as /intramaps90/default.htm, and TechnologyOne Cloud tenants at {council}.spatial.t1cloud.com/spatial/intramaps/. Distinct from ArcGIS Hub/REST on the same council and from TechnologyOne eProperty.

name: web-mapviewer
description: web-mapviewer is swisstopo's Vue/OpenLayers successor to mf-geoadmin3. map.geo.admin.ch ships versioned `/v1.x.x/assets/index-*.js` bundles over the geo.admin.ch layersConfig API. Distinct from mf-geoadmin3 forks.

MapGIS IGServer is Zondy Cyber's enterprise GIS server for publishing, managing, and sharing spatial data. .NET (often port 6163) and Java (often port 8089) editions expose a REST catalog under /igs/rest/ plus OGC WMS, WFS, WMTS, WCS, and CSW. IGS 1.0 lists map documents at /igs/rest/mrcs/docs; IGS 2.0 lists services at /igs/rest/services.
name: MapGIS IGServer

description: Lizmap is an open-source web GIS and geoportal platform built on QGIS Server for publishing, discovering, and sharing geospatial datasets, maps, and services. It supports standards-based interoperable geodata access and provides web and mobile clients for map viewing, search, and thematic exploration.
name: Lizmap
Palapa
description: Palapa (Geoportal Palapa / GSPalapa) is Badan Informasi Geospasial's open-source simpul jaringan geoportal for Indonesian ministries, provinces, and kabupaten/kota. Public nodes use title Geoportal Palapa, path /main/, login /gspalapa/, and a bundled GeoServer plus pycsw CSW at /csw. Distinct from GeoNode, standalone GeoServer catalogs, Ina-Geoportal, provincial /WebPortal/ shells, and CKAN hosts branded Satu Data Palapa.

name: Intertown UP
description: Intertown UP is Intertown's hosted GIS platform for Israeli regional councils, local councils, and planning committees. Public tenants live at up.intertown.co.il/{code}/public/ with the title "GIS Intertown" and per-tenant "UP by Intertown" branding; /org/ paths are the login-only internal systems. A React SPA on Intertown's open-source OpenGIS stack, with hybrid ArcGIS data-source support. Tenants include Nahal Sorek, Hevel Yavne, Hevel Modi'in, Merom HaGalil, Megiddo, and the Shur kot planning committee. One record per public tenant. The ags20.intertown.co.il ArcGIS Server endpoints are a separate arcgisserver stack.

MetaGIS is a geospatial data management and map publishing platform used to build geoportals and spatial data infrastructures. It focuses on managing metadata, publishing map services, and delivering web-based geographic discovery and visualization workflows for public-sector and research users.
name: Metagis
smart.finder SDI
description: smart.finder SDI is a geospatial discovery and metadata portal platform by con terra for building spatial data infrastructures. It supports catalog-based search, metadata management, and integration with OGC and API-driven geospatial services used by public-sector geoportals.

name: GiSoftGis
description: GiSoftGis is a municipal web GIS and city-guide product from GiSoft Bilgi Teknolojileri. Public city-guide apps are Angular SPAs at /GiSoftGis/#/cityguidepublic, with a gi-ajax-loading-indicator shell and the meta description Kent Rehberi Uygulaması.

name: GeoNode
description: GeoNode is an open-source platform for building spatial data infrastructures and geospatial data portals. It combines cataloging, search, metadata management, map composition, access control, and publishing workflows, and exposes data through OGC services and REST APIs. GeoNode is developed by an international open-source community and supported within the OSGeo ecosystem.

name: QGIS Server
description: QGIS Server is the OGC map and feature server bundled with QGIS. It publishes QGIS projects as WMS, WFS, WCS, and OGC API services (typical CGI/FastCGI path qgis_mapserv.fcgi, often with MAP=.qgs). Register it when QGIS Server is the public catalog. Do not add a second record when Lizmap, QWC2, or mviewer on the same host is the public product.

name: Loftmyndir
description: Loftmyndir Kortasjá is a hosted Icelandic municipal map viewer. Public tenants share www.map.is/{municipality}/ with Loftmyndir branding. Distinct from Alta Vefsjá (alta) on geo.alta.is and from other Icelandic kortasjá sites that are not Loftmyndir.

name: IGiS
description: IGiS is Scanpoint Geomatics' geospatial suite, developed with ISRO. Public municipal portals load the on-premises web widget at /CommonWidget/tools/IGiS_Widget/script/IGiS_Widget.js (GeoExt and OpenLayers 2) and often credit "Powered by Scanpoint Geomatics Ltd." Distinct from Serbian SmartGIS (smartgis), Greek GIS4Smart, and other products whose names only contain the letters GIS.

name: Hajk
description: Hajk is an open-source React, Material UI, and OpenLayers web GIS developed in Sweden. Municipal and agency public maps load appConfig.json with mapserviceBase pointing at /api/v1, /api/v2, or /mapservice. Distinct from Spatial Suite (spatialsuite) and GeoServer backends on the same estate.

name: InfoMap
description: InfoMap is Emtel's hosted New Zealand web-mapping product family. Public and Pro tenants expose an InfoMap Map Portal, commonly on *.infomap.co.nz or a council custom domain, and use QGIS Server as the map rendering backend. One tenant is one catalog; individual maps in its portal are not separate catalog records.

name: SeaSketch
description: SeaSketch is UCSB/NCEAS hosted marine spatial planning software. Public project map portals live at www.seasketch.org/{project}/app (title SeaSketch). Sketch editing often needs an account; overlay layers may be public. Distinct from ArcGIS REST on data.seasketch.org (arcgisserver). Do not register the marketing homepage as a catalog.

name: GeoNube
description: GeoNube is Cooperativa Cambalache's hosted Leaflet/bootleaf map platform for Argentine municipalities and organisations. Public tenants use geonube.com.ar/visor/{slug} or a custom domain that embeds those visors. Distinct from unrelated municipal IDEs that do not load GeoNube bootleaf assets.

name: KC WebGIS
description: KC WebGIS is Kommunal-Consult Becker's hosted municipal web GIS. Public BürgerGIS deployments use /BMApp/ on numbered gms*.kc-systemhaus.de hosts and share the product's Angular settings.js and application bundles. The platform publishes municipal plans, sites, infrastructure, trails, and other public themes and also supports field use and citizen reports.

name: Geoportál GEPRO
description: Geoportál GEPRO is GEPRO's municipal web GIS (OpenLayers client under /OUT/HTML/) used by Czech towns and ORP. Tenants live at {city}.obce.gepro.cz or {city}.gepro.cz. Distinct from desktop MISYS and from T-MAPY GISPLAN (gisplan) on gis4u.cz.

name: Marushka
description: Marushka is GEOVAP's map application server (.NET / GSFrameWork) used by Czech cities. Public HTML clients load zipped.js with title “Marushka - Mapový aplikační server” or a Blazor shell with js/marushka.js. Distinct from T-MAPY GISPLAN (gisplan) and Geoportál GEPRO (gepro).

name: SmartMet Server
description: SmartMet Server is the Finnish Meteorological Institute's open-source MetOcean data and product server. Public instances expose OGC WMS, WFS 2.0 stored queries, OGC API — EDR collections, and a /timeseries HTTP API, identified by the HTTP Server header SmartMet Server.

name: GovPilot GIS Map
description: GovPilot GIS Map is the public interactive mapping module of GovPilot's municipal government SaaS. Public tenants live at map.govpilot.com/map/{state}/{city} with the title "Interactive GIS Map of {CITY}, {STATE} | Powered by GovPilot" on a Telerik Kendo ASP.NET application, exposing municipal parcels, zoning, and administrative layers. One record per public tenant.

ORBISMap is a geospatial platform for publishing, managing, and visualizing spatial data in web geoportals and regional GIS systems. It supports high-load map services, integration with external systems, and API-based extension for custom applications.
name: ORBISMap
Xiltrion
description: Xiltrion is Dataxil's hosted multipurpose-cadastre platform. Its public municipal map clients use customer subdomains of xiltriongeoservicio.com, the /map route, an identical hashed Vite bundle, and Xiltrion-branded Mapbox styles. The shared client calls a first-party /api and supports public parcel mapping, municipal boundaries, thematic layers, and WMS sources; the wider authenticated application supports cadastral workflows.

name: mf-geoadmin3
description: mf-geoadmin3 is the open-source map viewer originally developed for map.geo.admin.ch by the Swiss Federal Office of Topography (swisstopo). Cantonal forks reuse the geoadmin3 frontend, layersConfig APIs, and Cesium/3D viewer stack.

name: Geometa
description: Geometa is a geospatial platform from Gems Development for urban planning, document workflows, and public GIS OGD geoportals. The Agate module publishes planning documents and map layers on official regional portals, typically under /agate_ paths.

name: CartoMapas
description: CartoMapas (also branded WKTApp Arade) is WKT-SI's older Portuguese municipal WebGIS. Public viewers load /static/build/js/bundle-map-app.js or credit WKT / WKTApp Arade, with title CartoMapas on some tenants. Distinct from the later ScalarGIS viewers that use title ScalarGIS and /static/viewer/.

qgis2web is an open-source QGIS plugin that exports the current map to a self-contained static web viewer (OpenLayers or Leaflet). Exports are typically uploaded as-is under a public path and carry recognizable assets (resources/qgis2web.js, resources/qgis2web.css, qgis2web_expressions.js) plus a layers/layers.js data file. Popular with municipal and cadastral GIS viewers, for example in Costa Rica and Lebanon.
name: qgis2web
ArcGIS Instant Apps
description: ArcGIS Instant Apps is Esri's template-based public map app (Basic, Sidebar, Lookup, Filter Gallery, Minimalist, and related templates). Public catalogs are at /apps/instant/{template}/index.html?appid= on *.maps.arcgis.com or Portal for ArcGIS. Distinct from ArcGIS Experience Builder (experiencebuilder), ArcGIS Web AppBuilder (webappbuilder), ArcGIS Hub (arcgishub), and ArcGIS Server REST (arcgisserver).

name: SmartGIS
description: SmartGIS is GEO's hosted and on-premises municipal Web GIS (2D/3D viewer and editor). Public tenants use HTML title SmartGIS, Angular app-root, and a point_cloud/viewer bootstrap on city hosts or {tenant}.geo.rs. Distinct from Kazakhstan SmartMap (smartmap), Greek GIS4Smart (gis4smart), Indonesian GeoNode hosts named smartgis, Malaysian ArcGIS smartGIS portals, and unrelated SmartGIS brands in Czechia, Indonesia, and Croatia.

name: CARTO
description: CARTO is a cloud-native spatial analytics and mapping platform for building geospatial data pipelines, running SQL-based geospatial analysis, and publishing interactive maps and location intelligence applications. It integrates with modern cloud data warehouses, supports enterprise governance, and provides APIs and developer tooling for data-driven geo applications.

name: GISPLAN
description: GISPLAN is T-MAPY's municipal web GIS (Spinbox / T-WIST gallery). Slovak tenants usually live at {city}.gisplan.sk or a city host that still loads tmapy.svg / Spinbox and public /mapa/ apps. Czech GIS4U tenants live at {muni}.gis4u.cz; T-WIST galleries also live at {city}.tmapserver.cz and on city hosts that load ost/filebox/ug_hm.php with t-wist_ren / tmapy.svg icons, or /theme/square/scripts/lock.min.js plus filterApps.js public galleries. Distinct from T-MAPY mOBEC (mobec) on mobec.sk tenants, Romanian GISApp (gisapp), Kaliopa iObčina (iobcina), Geoportál GEPRO (gepro), TopGis GisOnline (gisonline), Mapotip (mapotip), and CORA GEO CG WebGIS (cgwebgis). Login-only tenants without a public app gallery are not catalogs.

name: MapTiler Server
description: MapTiler Server is self-hosted software for publishing vector and raster map tiles, styles, and OGC services from an on-premises catalog. It exposes a public map list UI plus REST, WMTS, WMS, TileJSON, and OGC API — Tiles endpoints, typically on port 3650 or behind a reverse proxy.

name: STAC Browser
description: STAC Browser is an open-source web application for browsing SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog (STAC) static catalogs and STAC APIs. It provides collection and item navigation, map previews, metadata inspection, and asset download links for STAC metadata.

name: Nexus Public Portal
description: Nexus Public Portal is the public web GIS viewer of INS Nexus GIS (Skopje). Municipal tenants publish cadastral parcels, GUP/DUP urban plans, and related layers at {city}.ins.com.mk/NexusPublicPortal/PublicPortal/Map and on city hosts such as gis.{city}.gov.mk. HTML title is Map - Public GIS Portal or Мапа - Јавен ГИС портал. Distinct from Spanish enMapa (Nexus Geographics) and from Nexus Twin digital-twin portals. Skip vendor marketing (nexus.ins.com.mk), the nexusgis.ins.com.mk demo, Field GIS, and login-only AppCreator workflows.

name: GDi Visios
description: GDi Visios is the Web GIS viewer in the GDi Ensemble (formerly LOCALIS) suite. Public apps use path /visios/{app} or /Visios/{tenant}, title GDi Visios, and scripts from VisiosAPI/gdi_js. Used by Croatian cities and counties on their own hosts or on ensmartportal.gdi.net and localismarket.gdi.net. Distinct from ArcGIS Hub on other gdi.net hosts.

name: SHOGun
description: SHOGun is an open-source Spring Boot WebGIS framework by terrestris for configurable geoportals. Public clients load application configurations from REST /applications (optionally GraphQL) and render OpenLayers maps via shogun-gis-client. The stack typically includes GeoServer, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, and Keycloak. Distinct from GeoServer (geoserver), GeoNetwork (geonetwork), and Masterportal (masterportal) on the same estate.

name: GeoExplorer
description: GeoExplorer (branded "GEOhub") is a shared Saudi municipal web-GIS viewer deployed per municipality (amanat). Installations are hosted on municipal mapservice.* / webgis.* subdomains with a per-city path such as /HailGeoExplorer/ or /Asir_GeoExplorer, and serve a shared static asset root /MapControl_GeoExplorer/. The front end is a Blazor application built on the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript that consumes the municipality's map services, offering layer browsing, search and identify, and shapefile import/export.

name: Micka
description: Micka is an open-source geospatial metadata catalogue for ISO, OGC, and INSPIRE records. It provides a metadata editor, OGC CSW 2.0.2, GeoDCAT/ATOM exports, and INSPIRE ATOM download services used by Czech and other public geoportals.

name: NetGIS Runtime
description: NetGIS Runtime is WSP Danmark's municipal WebGIS viewer. Public maps live at municipal hosts under /NetGISRuntime/basis/index.jsp (often with custid or alias query params) and title NetGIS - © WSP Danmark. Distinct from Turkish Netcad NetGIS Server (netgisserver) and from German netgis.de MapServer clients. One record per municipal viewer, not the ArcGIS REST directory on the same commune.

name: Taldor MapExpert
description: Taldor MapExpert is the Taldor Group's hosted municipal GIS platform for Israeli local authorities. Public tenants live at gis{NN}.taldor.co.il/{City}Gis with a Hebrew interface covering parcels, planning, infrastructure, and municipal layers. Taldor has deployed GIS systems for dozens of Israeli authorities including Haifa, Herzliya, Ra'anana, Afula, Ness Ziona, Givatayim, and Netanya. One record per public tenant.

name: KOVGIS EVALD
description: KOVGIS EVALD is EOMAP / Geodata Arendus municipal web GIS for Estonian local governments. Public tenants live at evald.ee/{slug}/ (service.eomap.ee/{slug}/ redirects there) and expose planning, geoarchive, municipal land, and thematic layers. Distinct from ArcGIS Enterprise gis.{muni}.ee portals, Geoveeb survey archives, and login-only GeoBaas.

name: GeoNature
description: GeoNature is the open-source biodiversity information suite from French national parks (PnX-SI). Public GeoNature-atlas sites publish species sheets, maps, and observation summaries from a GeoNature/TaxHub backend (`/static/css/atlas.css`).

name: pGIS
description: pGIS is TOPODATI's hosted geographic-information browsing platform for Latvian municipalities. Deployments use customer subdomains of pgis.lv, title the Angular client pGIS, load the same hashed main and styles bundles, and expose a JSON layer-classifier API under /api/v1/classifiers/layers. The vendor service includes WMS and WFS services, initial data import, and one municipal tenant per subscription.

name: TerraWeb
description: TerraWeb is Terraplan's German municipal WebGIS. Public tenants live at {tenant}.terragis.de and on custom Kreis domains, with an OpenLayers launcher, terraweb.js, and guest viewers at login-ol.htm?login=gast (or a named public account such as buergerauskunft). Distinct from Latvian terGIS (tergis) and from Terria (terria). Do not register the vendor marketing homepage terragis.de or TerraSchüler / TerraIndividual apps.

name: KAZGISA OpenLayers WebGIS
description: Legacy KAZGISA regional WebGIS product used by Kazakhstani public authorities before the current Angular-based KAZGISA RGIS generation. Deployments use an OpenLayers and Knockout client with shared Components, Scripts, and src/viewmodel asset trees, commonly backed by GeoServer services.

name: NieuwlandGeo Onemap
description: NieuwlandGeo Onemap is a Dutch municipal map SaaS. Public tenants live at {org}.webgis.nl with an Onemap / WebGIS viewer. Distinct from Singapore OneMap, NC OneMap, Maldives OneMap, and from GeoServer backends on the same organisation. One record per public tenant, not the vendor demo at webgis.nl or onemap.nl.

Esri Geoportal Server is a metadata catalog platform for discovering and sharing geospatial resources across organizations. It supports standards-based cataloging and federated search, including CSW and OpenSearch interfaces, and can index metadata records from multiple systems for spatial data infrastructure and open data discovery workflows.
name: Esri Geoportal Server
Geoambiental
description: Geoambiental is SIGMA Ingenieria's proprietary geographic and management platform for Colombian environmental authorities. Its public cartographic viewers use organization-specific geoambiental.co subdomains, the /content-layout route, a Geoambiental page title, and matching Angular vendor and stylesheet bundles. The wider platform manages environmental permits, monitoring, indicators, reports, and structured cartography and is offered as software as a service.

name: EnviMAP
description: EnviMAP is Envirosense Hungary's municipal zoning-plan GIS. Public tenants include {city}.envimap.hu (Fót EnviMAP SPA, Debrecen GeoForte) and InterMap GeoForte viewers at /hu/Admin/GeoForte/GeoEdit (Dunakeszi on intermap.hu). Distinct from Autodesk MapGuide (Érd) and from old MapFish viewers (Újbuda).

name: MapBiomas
description: MapBiomas is a land-cover mapping and geospatial data platform used to publish annual land-use collections, map viewers, and downloadable geospatial products. Country deployments such as Brazil and Indonesia share the same MapBiomas web application.

name: Nazca4U Rapportagemodule
description: Nazca4U Rapportagemodule is Dutch company Nazca's hosted soil-information reporting application for provinces, omgevingsdiensten, and municipalities. Public tenants live at {tenant}.nazca4u.nl/rapportage/ and serve the same ASP.NET application with /Rapportage/Geolocator/{Map,Toolbar,Legend}/ assets and App_Themes/RapportageModule/*.css. Users look up bodeminformatie by address, parcel, or map selection and receive a PDF report by e-mail; underlying bodemonderzoek reports are linked where available. Distinct from NAZCA, Soltesoft's Colombian cadastral viewer (nazca). One record per public tenant.

name: ArcGIS Experience Builder
description: ArcGIS Experience Builder is Esri's configurable web app for maps and data-driven pages. Public catalogs are hosted at experience.arcgis.com/experience/{id}, on Portal for ArcGIS at /portal/apps/experiencebuilder/experience/?id=, or on a custom domain that loads jimu-core/init.js (title Experience, favicon exb.ico). Swedish Länsstyrelsen WebbGIS tenants on ext-webbgis.lansstyrelsen.se are this product. Distinct from ArcGIS Hub (arcgishub), ArcGIS Server REST (arcgisserver), ArcGIS Web AppBuilder (webappbuilder), ArcGIS Instant Apps (instantapps), and Esri Finland dmCity (dmcity).

name: enMapa
description: enMapa is a municipal web GIS by Nexus Geographics (Catalonia, Spain) used by Spanish town councils. Public tenants live at {city}.enmapa.com behind Cloudflare and on city hosts such as geoportal.{city}.cat/visor/guia or mapes.{city}.cat/geoportal/ (Geoportal Urbanístic) with HTML title Enmapa / EnMapa v4.x or '{city}. Geoportal Urbanístic', OpenLayers, and nexus Matomo. Distinct from the CKAN open-data tenants some councils run on the same host family ({city}-opendata.enmapa.com). Do not register dev/admin/demo subdomains.

name: GeoServer
description: GeoServer is an open-source geospatial server for publishing and managing vector and raster data through OGC standards and REST APIs. It enables organizations to serve interoperable map and feature services (WMS, WFS, WCS, WMTS), style layers with SLD, transform and export data in multiple formats, and build spatial data infrastructures and open-data geoportals.

name: XY Maps
description: XY Maps is Eckersall municipal GIS (XY • MAPS). Public cloud tenants live at maps.xymaps.com/{city} (www.xymaps.com is the same app); city-hosted viewers use /xymaps/Map. HTML title City Maps powered by XY MAPS or Welcome to XY MAPS; /Content/themes/themesAll/xymaps.css. Distinct from Geocortex and ArcGIS viewers Eckersall also builds. Do not register the marketing homepage, staff login, or private floorplan dumps.

name: GC Navi
description: GC Navi is Informatix's public WebGIS (GeoCloud / GeoConic) for Japanese local governments. Cloud tenants are commonly hosted on {organization}.geocloud.jp/webgis/ with bt/p query parameters. The product is distinct from the internal GC Planets integrated GIS.

Rasdaman is an array database and geospatial analytics platform for managing and processing multi-dimensional raster data via OGC-compliant web services. It is used for scalable Earth observation and scientific data infrastructures.
name: Rasdaman
CartoVista
description: CartoVista is a commercial interactive web-mapping platform with cloud and self-hosted publishing options. CartoVista Server portals expose paths such as /CartoVistaServer/maps/view and load versioned cartovistawebportal-* assets. The platform publishes map galleries, interactive thematic maps, dashboards, and linked data views.

name: mOBEC
description: mOBEC is T-MAPY's municipal map portal for smaller Slovak towns and villages. Public tenants live at mobec.sk/{slug} (optional hash-base path), load /img/tmapyn.svg, set a numeric tenant ido, and title the public map Všeobecná mapa. Distinct from GISPLAN Spinbox galleries (gisplan) on {city}.gisplan.sk. Staff login chrome on the same SPA does not make the public map a non-catalog.

name: GISApp
description: GISApp is Fida Solutions / Urbanova municipal GIS used by Romanian cities. Tenants live at {city}.gisapp.ro and on city-owned hosts (gis.primaria*.ro, urbanism.*) that show PortalPublic UI and logo_fida.png. ArcGIS REST on webadaptor.gisapp.ro stays arcgisserver. Distinct from Kaliopa iObčina (iobcina) and from EQWC despite the shared gisapp path name.

name: dmCity
description: dmCity is Esri Finland's municipal digital-city SaaS. Public map tenants live at web.dmcity.fi/{city}/public/ with title dmCity Web App and jimu-core/init.js (Experience Builder shell). Distinct from generic ArcGIS Experience Builder (experiencebuilder) on other hosts and from ArcGIS Server REST on {city}.dmcity.fi/server (arcgisserver). One record per public city tenant, not the marketing site.

PopGIS is a geospatial data portal platform used by Pacific institutions to publish and access maps, layers, and related geographic information through web mapping interfaces and interoperable geospatial services.
name: PopGIS
Exponare
description: Exponare is MapInfo / Pitney Bowes (now Precisely) municipal web GIS, the predecessor to Spectrum Spatial Analyst. Public sites use /exponare/RestPublicApplication.aspx, /exponare/PublicApplication.aspx, /exponare/publicinvoker.aspx, or a council mapping.aspx wrapper that still loads Exponare. Distinct from Spectrum Spatial Analyst (/connect/analyst/), IntraMaps, and ArcGIS Hub/REST on the same owner.

GC2 (GeoCloud 2) is an open-source spatial-data platform from MapCentia, often paired with the Vidi browser GIS client. It deploys PostGIS, MapServer or QGIS Server, MapCache, and Elasticsearch, and exposes layers through a SQL API, WMS, WFS, and WMTS. Danish municipalities commonly host tenants on mapcentia.com or gc2.io.
name: GC2
myCarta
description: myCarta WebMap is Aveki's municipal web GIS for Swedish kommuner. Public maps use title myCarta WebMap with meta "a client map application from Aveki AB", path /webmap/ or /mycartawebmap/, or older js/emap.js. Distinct from Hajk (hajk) on other Swedish karta.* hosts. Skip login-only myCarta GO and the Aveki marketing site.

name: MuniSight
description: MuniSight (Catalis GIS WebMap) is a Canadian municipal GIS SaaS. Public tenants live at web.munisight.com/{Tenant} and share Login.aspx, App_Themes/Catalis, and CloudFront JS 3.9.x. Distinct from MRF Web Map (mrf), GIS Cloud (giscloud), and generic Hexagon GeoMedia WebMap (geomediawebmap) Geospatial Portal paths. Do not register the marketing homepage. Staff login walls are still the same product.

name: eLiteGIS
description: eLiteGIS is a server-based platform for building geographic information system (GIS) solutions, GIS portals, and spatial data infrastructures. It provides REST API services compatible with ArcGIS Server protocols and is commonly used with CoGIS to support online and offline map workflows.

name: InGeo
description: InGeo (ГИС ИнГео) is a geospatial platform from CSI Integro for municipal and regional GIS. Desktop InGeo maintains topographic and urban-planning maps; InGeo-Web publishes general plans, land-use rules, and other spatial data as public geoportals.

name: Myeongji WebGIS
description: Myeongji WebGIS is the municipal living-information map platform of Myeongji Information Technology (명지정보기술), a Korean GIS company in Jeonju. Deployments share one OpenLayers 2 client codebase identified by /js/base/MapSave.js, /js/base/BaseMap.js, /js/base/SeeMap.js, and /js/base/mapsave/MapSaveTool.js, and carry titles like 생활지리정보시스템 or 생활공간정보안내시스템. The Iksan deployment credits 명지정보기술 in its footer. Do not infer the platform from a Korean "Life Map" title or the Korean public-sector /common/ web template alone; the shared base JS assets are required.

name: Stroly
description: Stroly is a Kyoto-based hosted platform for publishing and viewing georeferenced historical and illustrated maps. Museums, libraries and municipalities upload old maps that users browse overlaid on modern maps with GPS positioning.

name: SIGALE
description: SIGALE is the Fédération québécoise des municipalités graphic-matrix and assessment-roll GIS (Altus). Public tenants live at sigale.ca/Main.aspx?mrc={code} or sigale.ca/?mrc={code} with a Contribuable municipality picker. Distinct from Geocentriq, GeoCentralis, SIGimWeb, and GOnet. One record per public MRC code, not per municipality in the picker. Do not register the hub without an mrc parameter.

name: Geotrek
description: Geotrek is the open-source outdoor and trail management suite from French national parks (GeotrekCE / Parc national des Écrins). Public catalogs are Geotrek-rando sites (v2 Angular or v3 Next.js) that list treks, outdoor sites, and tourism contents from a Geotrek-admin API (`/api/v2/trek/`).

name: Visor Urbano
description: Visor Urbano is Guadalajara's municipal urban-management GIS, replicated across Mexican cities with Bloomberg Philanthropies support. Public tenants use visorurbano.{city}.gob.mx or {city}.visorurbano.com for cadastral lookup, land-use consultation, and business or construction licences. Distinct from unrelated Leaflet city visors that reuse the "Visor Urbano" label (for example visorguadalupe.com).

name: map.apps
description: map.apps is a commercial WebGIS application framework from con terra for building map viewers and geoportals on top of ArcGIS and OGC services. Public deployments are typically served from a /mapapps/ path.

name: XPortal
description: XPortal is the municipal public GIS portal engine by Intergraph Computer Services (Romania), sold inside the Ingeea suite (product page "Pachetul Hartă de Public"; Sibiu deployment brands itself IngeeaCity Public). Modern deployments are ASP.NET apps (IIS/Kestrel) loading Kendo UI for jQuery webpack bundles (vendors.bundle.js, ClientEventManager.js, kendo.aspnetmvc.min.js) under xportal*-prefixed paths such as /xportalurb or /xportalBacau_public; the login screen reads XPortal with footer "powered by Intergraph Computer Services".
